# How to use

This overview of probability distributions, will (where available) contain the following content on each distribution:

-   Where to use

-   Notation

-   Parameter(s) for use

-   Mean/expected value. In all cases, the mean equals the expected value, and the expected value of $X$ will be represented as $\mathbb{E}(X)$. See [Guide: Expected values, variance, standard deviation](../studyguides/expectedvariance.qmd) for more.

-   Variance, which is represented as $\mathbb{V}(X)$. See [Guide: Expected values, variance, standard deviation](../studyguides/expectedvariance.qmd) for more.

-   Probability mass function (PMF) for discrete random variables, or the probability density function (PDF) for continuous random variables. See [Guide: PMFs, PDFs, CDFs](../studyguides/pmfspdfscdfs.qmd) for more.

-   Cumulative distribution function (CDF), where possible. See [Guide: PMFs, PDFs, CDFs](../studyguides/pmfspdfscdfs.qmd) for more.

-   Interactive figure, where possible.

-   Example of usage.

Although this overview is not an exhaustive list of all possible probability distributions, this overview can be treated as an introduction to commonly used types of distributions.

# Discrete random variables

## Uniform distribution (discrete) {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The discrete uniform distribution is used when all integer outcomes $x$ in the interval $a$ to $b$ are equally likely. $X$ is a random variable for integer outcomes $x$ where for $a \leq x \leq b$, and the probability of each outcome $1/n$, where $n = b - a + 1$.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Uniform}(a,b)$ or $X \sim U(a,b)$

**Parameters:** The numbers $a,b$ are integers where

-   $a$ is the minimum value of an outcome
-   $b$ is the maximum value of an outcome

There are $n$ outcomes in total, with $n = b - a + 1$.

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{a+b}{2}.$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{n^2-1}{12}.$ |  |
| **PMF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\frac{1}{n}$ |  |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)= \begin{cases} 0 & \textsf{if } x \leq a \\\dfrac{\lfloor x \rfloor - a + 1}{n} & \textsf{if } a< x<b \\1 & \textsf{if } x \geq b \end{cases}$ | $\lfloor x \rfloor$ is the **floor function** |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{a+b}{2}.$ -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{(b-a+1)^2-1}{12}.$ -->

<!-- **PMF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\frac{1}{n}$ where $n=b-a+1$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)= \begin{cases} 0 & \textsf{if } x \leq a \\\dfrac{\lfloor x \rfloor - a + 1}{n} & \textsf{if } a< x<b \\1 & \textsf{if } x \geq b \end{cases}$  -->

<!-- where $n=b-a+1$ and $\lfloor x \rfloor$ is the **floor function** applied to $x$, equal to the largest integer $z$ such that $z\leq x$. -->

```{=html}
<div class="distribution-calculator discrete-uniform-calculator">

  <div class="calculator-row">

            type="range"
            id="uniform-x"
            min="1"
            max="6"
            value="3"
            step="1"
            class="distribution-slider">

          <div class="slider-value" id="uniform-x-value">3</div>
        </div>

        <!-- LOWER / UPPER VALUES -->
        <div id="uniform-between-container" class="conditional-input" hidden>
          <label for="uniform-lower">Lower bound (x):</label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="uniform-lower"
            min="1"
            max="6"

            step="1"
            class="distribution-slider">

          <div class="slider-value" id="uniform-lower-value">2</div>

            Upper bound (y):
          </label>

      </div>

</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   DISCRETE UNIFORM DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {
  "use strict";

  const root = document.querySelector(".discrete-uniform-calculator");
  if (!root) return;

  const minimumInput = root.querySelector("#uniform-minimum");
  const maximumInput = root.querySelector("#uniform-maximum");
  const xInput = root.querySelector("#uniform-x");
  const lowerInput = root.querySelector("#uniform-lower");
  const upperInput = root.querySelector("#uniform-upper");

  const xDisplay = root.querySelector("#uniform-x-value");
  const lowerDisplay = root.querySelector("#uniform-lower-value");
  const upperDisplay = root.querySelector("#uniform-upper-value");

  const error = root.querySelector("#uniform-parameter-error");
  const title = root.querySelector("#uniform-plot-title");
  const result = root.querySelector("#uniform-result");
  const xContainer = root.querySelector("#uniform-x-container");
  const betweenContainer = root.querySelector("#uniform-between-container");
  const canvas = root.querySelector("#uniform-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function validateParameters() {
    const minimum = Number(minimumInput.value);
    const maximum = Number(maximumInput.value);
    let message = "";

    if (!Number.isInteger(minimum) || !Number.isInteger(maximum)) {
      message = "The minimum and maximum must both be whole numbers.";
    } else if (maximum < minimum) {
      message = "The maximum value must be greater than or equal to the minimum value.";
    } else if (maximum - minimum + 1 > 100) {
      message = "Please use a range containing no more than 100 integer values.";
    }

    error.textContent = message;
    minimumInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", message ? "true" : "false");
    maximumInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", message ? "true" : "false");

    return message ? null : { minimum, maximum };
  }

  function getProbabilityType() {
    const selected = root.querySelector(
      'input[name="uniform-prob-type"]:checked'
    );

    return selected ? selected.value : "less";
  }

  function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) {
    return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, value));
  }

  function updateRanges(parameters) {
    const minimum = parameters.minimum;
    const maximum = parameters.maximum;

    [xInput, lowerInput, upperInput].forEach(function(input) {
      input.min = minimum;
      input.max = maximum;
      input.step = 1;

      const current = parseInt(input.value, 10);
      input.value = Number.isFinite(current)
        ? clamp(current, minimum, maximum)
        : minimum;
    });

    if (parseInt(upperInput.value, 10) < parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
  }

  function updateDisplay(parameters) {
    updateRanges(parameters);

    xDisplay.textContent = parseInt(xInput.value, 10);
    lowerDisplay.textContent = parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10);
    upperDisplay.textContent = parseInt(upperInput.value, 10);

    title.textContent =
      `Discrete Uniform(a = ${parameters.minimum}, b = ${parameters.maximum})`;
  }

  function countValuesBetween(lower, upper, minimum, maximum) {
    const effectiveLower = Math.max(lower, minimum);
    const effectiveUpper = Math.min(upper, maximum);

    return effectiveUpper < effectiveLower
      ? 0
      : effectiveUpper - effectiveLower + 1;
  }

  function calculateProbability(parameters) {
    const minimum = parameters.minimum;
    const maximum = parameters.maximum;
    const totalValues = maximum - minimum + 1;
    const x = parseInt(xInput.value, 10);
    let lower = parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10);
    let upper = parseInt(upperInput.value, 10);
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    let favourableValues;
    let probability;

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper;
      upperDisplay.textContent = upper;
    }

    if (type === "less") {
      favourableValues = countValuesBetween(
        minimum,
        x,
        minimum,
        maximum
      );

      probability = favourableValues / totalValues;

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${x}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if (type === "greater") {
      favourableValues = countValuesBetween(
        x,
        maximum,
        minimum,
        maximum
      );

      probability = favourableValues / totalValues;

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${x}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      favourableValues = countValuesBetween(
        lower,
        upper,
        minimum,
        maximum
      );

      probability = favourableValues / totalValues;

      result.textContent =
        `P(${lower} ≤ X ≤ ${upper}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }

    return {
      type,
      x,
      lower,
      upper,
      probability,
      minimum,
      maximum,
      totalValues
    };
  }

  function drawChart(parameters) {
    const selected = calculateProbability(parameters);
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 58, right: 20, top: 25, bottom: 52 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const probabilityMass = 1 / selected.totalValues;
    const maximumY = probabilityMass * 1.25;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    function xScale(value) {
      const index = value - selected.minimum;

      return padding.left +
        ((index + 0.5) / selected.totalValues) * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      return padding.top + chartHeight -
        (value / maximumY) * chartHeight;
    }

    /* GRID AND Y-AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const value = (i / 4) * maximumY;
      const y = yScale(value);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(value.toFixed(2), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    /* PMF BARS */

    const availableWidth = chartWidth / selected.totalValues;
    const barWidth = Math.max(2, Math.min(42, availableWidth * 0.72));
    const barHeight = (probabilityMass / maximumY) * chartHeight;

    for (
      let value = selected.minimum;
      value <= selected.maximum;
      value++
    ) {
      const x = xScale(value) - barWidth / 2;
      const y = padding.top + chartHeight - barHeight;
      let highlighted = false;

      if (selected.type === "less") {
        highlighted = value <= selected.x;
      } else if (selected.type === "greater") {
        highlighted = value >= selected.x;
      } else {
        highlighted =
          value >= selected.lower &&
          value <= selected.upper;
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = highlighted ? "#3F6BB6" : "#d3d3d3";
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);
    }

    /* AXES */

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    /* X-AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    const labelInterval = selected.totalValues <= 15
      ? 1
      : selected.totalValues <= 30
        ? 2
        : Math.ceil(selected.totalValues / 15);

    for (
      let value = selected.minimum;
      value <= selected.maximum;
      value++
    ) {
      const isEndpoint =
        value === selected.minimum ||
        value === selected.maximum;

      if (isEndpoint || (value - selected.minimum) % labelInterval === 0) {
        ctx.fillText(
          value,
          xScale(value),
          padding.top + chartHeight + 20
        );
      }
    }

    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(
      "value of X",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("probability mass function", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `Discrete uniform probability mass function from ` +
      `${selected.minimum} to ${selected.maximum}. Each value has probability ` +
      `${probabilityMass.toFixed(4)}. The selected probability is ` +
      `${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`
    );
  }

  function updateVisibility() {
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    xContainer.hidden = type === "between";
    betweenContainer.hidden = type !== "between";
  }

  function update() {
    updateVisibility();

    const parameters = validateParameters();

    if (!parameters) {
      result.textContent = "Enter valid distribution limits to calculate a probability.";
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      return;
    }

    updateDisplay(parameters);
    drawChart(parameters);
  }

  minimumInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  maximumInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  xInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  lowerInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10) > parseInt(upperInput.value, 10)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }

    update();
  });

  upperInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseInt(upperInput.value, 10) < parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10)) {
      lowerInput.value = upperInput.value;
    }

    update();
  });

  root.querySelectorAll('input[name="uniform-prob-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(update, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

```

**Example:** You roll a fair six-sided die, where all outcomes ($1, 2, 3, 4, 5,$ and $6$) are equally likely. This can be expressed as $X \sim U(1,6)$. It means $1$ is the minimum value and $6$ is the maximum value, where all discrete values of $X$ for $1 \leq x \leq 6$ are equally likely.

## Bernoulli distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The Bernoulli distribution is used for binary data, where one trial is conducted with only two possible outcomes. Examples include success/failure, yes/no, and heads/tails. $X$ indicates whether the trial is a success (when $X=1$) or failure (when $X=0$).

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(p)$

**Parameter:** The real number $p$ is the probability of success in a trial (where $0 \le p \le 1$).

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = p$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = p(1-p)$ |  |
| **PMF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\begin{cases} 1-p & \textsf{if }x=0 \\p & \textsf{if }x=1\end{cases}$ |  |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)= \begin{cases} 0 & \textsf{if } x< 0 \\1-p & \textsf{if } 0\leq x<1 \\p & \textsf{if } x\geq1 \end{cases}$ |  |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = p$ -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X)=p(1-p)$ -->

<!-- **PMF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\begin{cases} 1-p & \textsf{if }x=0 \\p & \textsf{if }x=1\end{cases}$ -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)= \begin{cases} 0 & \textsf{if } x< 0 \\1-p & \textsf{if } 0\leq x<1 \\p & \textsf{if } x\geq1 \end{cases}$ -->


**Example:** You flip a coin, and the probability of getting ‘heads’ is $0.5$. Taking ‘heads’ as a success, this can be expressed as $X \sim \textrm{Bernoulli}(0.5)$, meaning the probability of success in each trial is $0.5$.

## Binomial distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The binomial distribution is used when there are a fixed number of trials ($n$) and only two possible outcomes for each trial, representing $n$ many Bernoulli trials. Here, the random variable $X$ represents the number of successes.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Binomial}(n,p)$ or $X \sim B(n,p)$.

**Parameters:** Two numbers $n,p$ where: - $n$ is an integer representing the number of trials, - $p$ is a real number representing the probability of success of a trial (where $0 \le p \le 1$).

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = np$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = np(1-p)$ |  |
| **PMF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{n!}{(n-x)!x!}p^xq^{(n-x)}$ |  |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=I_{q}(n-\lfloor x \rfloor,1+\lfloor x \rfloor)$ | $I_x(a,b)$ regularized incomplete beta function, $\lfloor x \rfloor$ the floor function |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = np$ -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = np(1-p)$ -->

<!-- **PMF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{n!}{(n-x)!x!}p^xq^{(n-x)}$ -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=I_{q}(n-\lfloor x \rfloor,1+\lfloor x \rfloor)$ where $I_{x}(a,b)$ is the regularized incomplete beta function for $a$ and $b$ with $x$ being the upper bound for integration, and $\lfloor x \rfloor$ is the **floor function** applied to $x$, equal to the largest integer $z$ such that $z\leq x$. -->

```{=html}
<script>

/* =========================================================
   BINOMIAL DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {

  const nInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-n");

  const pInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-p");

  const xInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-x");

  const lowerInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-lower");

  const upperInput =
    document.getElementById("binomial-upper");

  const pDisplay =
    document.getElementById("binomial-p-value");

  const xDisplay =
    document.getElementById("binomial-x-value");

  const lowerDisplay =
    document.getElementById("binomial-lower-value");

  const upperDisplay =
    document.getElementById("binomial-upper-value");

  const title =
    document.getElementById("binomial-plot-title");

  const result =
    document.getElementById("binomial-result");

  const xContainer =
    document.getElementById("binomial-x-container");

  const betweenContainer =
    document.getElementById("binomial-between-container");

  const canvas =
    document.getElementById("binomial-chart");

  const ctx =
    canvas.getContext("2d");


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     BINOMIAL PMF
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function logGamma(z) {

    const coefficients = [
      676.5203681218851,
      -1259.1392167224028,
      771.32342877765313,
      -176.61502916214059,
      12.507343278686905,
      -0.13857109526572012,
      9.9843695780195716e-6,
      1.5056327351493116e-7
    ];

    if (z < 0.5) {
      return Math.log(Math.PI)
        - Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI * z))
        - logGamma(1 - z);
    }

    z -= 1;

    let x = 0.99999999999980993;

    for (let i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
      x += coefficients[i] / (z + i + 1);
    }

    const t = z + coefficients.length - 0.5;

    return (
      0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) +
      (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) -
      t +
      Math.log(x)
    );
  }


  function binomialPMF(k, n, p) {

    if (k < 0 || k > n) {
      return 0;
    }

    if (p === 0) {
      return k === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }

    if (p === 1) {
      return k === n ? 1 : 0;
    }

    const logProbability =
      logGamma(n + 1) -
      logGamma(k + 1) -
      logGamma(n - k + 1) +
      k * Math.log(p) +
      (n - k) * Math.log(1 - p);

    return Math.exp(logProbability);
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CUMULATIVE PROBABILITY
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function cumulativeProbability(k, n, p) {

    if (k < 0) return 0;

    if (k >= n) return 1;

    let total = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
      total += binomialPMF(i, n, p);
    }

    return total;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CURRENT TEST TYPE
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function getTestType() {

    const selected =
      document.querySelector(
        'input[name="binomial-prob-type"]:checked'
      );

    return selected
      ? selected.value
      : "less";
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     UPDATE SLIDER RANGES
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function updateRanges() {

    let n =
      parseInt(nInput.value, 10);

    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1) {
      n = 1;
      nInput.value = 1;
    }

    xInput.max = n;
    lowerInput.max = n;
    upperInput.max = n;

    if (parseInt(xInput.value,10) > n) {
      xInput.value = n;
    }

    if (parseInt(lowerInput.value,10) > n) {
      lowerInput.value = n;
    }

    if (parseInt(upperInput.value,10) > n) {
      upperInput.value = n;
    }

    if (
      parseInt(upperInput.value,10) <
      parseInt(lowerInput.value,10)
    ) {
      upperInput.value =
        lowerInput.value;
    }

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     UPDATE DISPLAY
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function updateDisplay() {

    updateRanges();

    const n =
      parseInt(nInput.value,10);

    const p =
      parseFloat(pInput.value);

    const x =
      parseInt(xInput.value,10);

    const lower =
      parseInt(lowerInput.value,10);

    const upper =
      parseInt(upperInput.value,10);

    pDisplay.textContent =
      p.toFixed(2);

    xDisplay.textContent =
      x;

    lowerDisplay.textContent =
      lower;

    upperDisplay.textContent =
      upper;

    title.textContent =
      `Bin(n = ${n}, p = ${p.toFixed(2)})`;

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CALCULATE RESULT
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function calculateProbability() {

    const n =
      parseInt(nInput.value,10);

    const p =
      parseFloat(pInput.value);

    const x =
      parseInt(xInput.value,10);

    let lower =
      parseInt(lowerInput.value,10);

    let upper =
      parseInt(upperInput.value,10);

    const type =
      getTestType();


    if (upper < lower) {

      upper = lower;

      upperInput.value =
        upper;

      upperDisplay.textContent =
        upper;

    }


    let probability;


    if (type === "less") {

      probability =
        cumulativeProbability(
          x,
          n,
          p
        );

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${x}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;

    }


    else if (type === "greater") {

      if (x === 0) {

        probability = 1;

      } else {

        probability =
          1 -
          cumulativeProbability(
            x - 1,
            n,
            p
          );

      }

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${x}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;

    }


    else {

      if (lower === upper) {

        probability =
          binomialPMF(
            lower,
            n,
            p
          );

      } else {

        const upperProbability =
          cumulativeProbability(
            upper,
            n,
            p
          );

        const lowerProbability =
          lower === 0
            ? 0
            : cumulativeProbability(
                lower - 1,
                n,
                p
              );

        probability =
          upperProbability -
          lowerProbability;

      }

      result.textContent =
        `P(${lower} ≤ X ≤ ${upper}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;

    }


    return {
      type,
      x,
      lower,
      upper,
      probability
    };

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     DRAW CHART
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function drawChart() {

    const n =
      parseInt(nInput.value,10);

    const p =
      parseFloat(pInput.value);

    const res =
      calculateProbability();


    const rect =
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    const dpr =
      window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

    canvas.width =
      rect.width * dpr;

    canvas.height =
      rect.height * dpr;

    ctx.setTransform(
      dpr,
      0,
      0,
      dpr,
      0,
      0
    );


    const width =
      rect.width;

    const height =
      rect.height;


    ctx.clearRect(
      0,
      0,
      width,
      height
    );


    const padding = {
      left: 55,
      right: 20,
      top: 25,
      bottom: 50
    };


    const chartWidth =
      width -
      padding.left -
      padding.right;

    const chartHeight =
      height -
      padding.top -
      padding.bottom;


    const probabilities = [];

    for(let k=0;k<=n;k++) {

      probabilities.push(
        binomialPMF(k,n,p)
      );

    }


    const maxProbability =
      Math.max(...probabilities);


    function xScale(k) {

      if(n === 0) {
        return padding.left;
      }

      return padding.left +
        (k / n) *
        chartWidth;

    }


    function yScale(value) {

      return padding.top +
        chartHeight -
        (value / maxProbability) *
        chartHeight *
        0.9;

    }


    /* GRID */

    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "#e5e5e5";

    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    for(let i=0;i<=4;i++) {

      const y =
        padding.top +
        chartHeight -
        (i/4) *
        chartHeight;

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.moveTo(
        padding.left,
        y
      );

      ctx.lineTo(
        width - padding.right,
        y
      );

      ctx.stroke();

    }


    /* AXIS */

    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "#777";

    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.moveTo(
      padding.left,
      padding.top + chartHeight
    );

    ctx.lineTo(
      width - padding.right,
      padding.top + chartHeight
    );

    ctx.stroke();


    /* BARS */

    const barWidth =
      Math.max(
        2,
        Math.min(
          40,
          chartWidth / (n + 1) * 0.72
        )
      );


    for(let k=0;k<=n;k++) {

      const probability =
        probabilities[k];

      const barHeight =
        (probability / maxProbability) *
        chartHeight *
        0.9;

      const x =
        xScale(k) -
        barWidth / 2;

      const y =
        padding.top +
        chartHeight -
        barHeight;


      let highlighted = false;


      if(res.type === "less") {

        highlighted =
          k <= res.x;

      }

      else if(res.type === "greater") {

        highlighted =
          k >= res.x;

      }

      else if(res.type === "between") {

        highlighted =
          k >= res.lower &&
          k <= res.upper;

      }


      ctx.fillStyle =
        highlighted
          ? "#3F6BB6"
          : "#d3d3d3";


      ctx.fillRect(
        x,
        y,
        barWidth,
        barHeight
      );


      ctx.strokeStyle =
        "#777";

      ctx.strokeRect(
        x,
        y,
        barWidth,
        barHeight
      );

    }


    /* X AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.fillStyle =
      "#333";

    ctx.font =
      "12px Arial";

    ctx.textAlign =
      "center";

    for(let k=0;k<=n;k++) {

      const x =
        xScale(k);

      ctx.fillText(
        k,
        x,
        padding.top +
        chartHeight +
        20
      );

    }


    /* X LABEL */

    ctx.font =
      "13px Arial";

    ctx.fillText(
      "number of successes (X)",
      padding.left +
      chartWidth/2,
      height - 8
    );


    /* Y LABEL */

    ctx.save();

    ctx.translate(
      15,
      padding.top +
      chartHeight/2
    );

    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);

    ctx.textAlign =
      "center";

    ctx.fillText(
      "probability mass function",
      0,
      0
    );

    ctx.restore();

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     VISIBILITY
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function updateVisibility() {

    const type =
      getTestType();

    if(
      type === "less" ||
      type === "greater"
    ) {

      xContainer.hidden = false;

      betweenContainer.hidden = true;

    } else {

      xContainer.hidden = true;

      betweenContainer.hidden = false;

    }

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     MASTER UPDATE
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function update() {

    updateVisibility();

    updateDisplay();

    drawChart();

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     EVENT LISTENERS
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  nInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );

  pInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );

  xInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );

  lowerInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    function() {

      if(
        parseInt(upperInput.value,10) <
        parseInt(lowerInput.value,10)
      ) {

        upperInput.value =
          lowerInput.value;

      }

      update();

    }
  );

  upperInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );


  document
    .querySelectorAll(
      'input[name="binomial-prob-type"]'
    )
    .forEach(
      radio =>
        radio.addEventListener(
          "change",
          update
        )
    );


  window.addEventListener(
    "resize",
    drawChart
  );


  /* INITIALISE */

  update();

})();

</script>

```

**Example:** You flip a coin $10$ times, and the probability of getting ‘heads’ is $0.5$. Taking ‘heads’ as a success, this can be expressed as $X \sim B(10, 0.5)$, meaning $10$ trials are conducted, where the probability of success in each trial is $0.5$.

## Multinomial distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The multinomial distribution is used when there are a fixed number of trials ($n$) and more than two possible outcomes for each trial. $X_{i}$ represents the number of times a specific outcome occurs. Therefore, the mean, variance, and expected value of multinomial distributions are calculated for each $X_{i}$, not $X$.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Multinomial}(n,\mathbf{p})$ or $X \sim M(n,\mathbf{p})$

**Parameters:** Three parameters $n,k,\mathbf{p}$, where

-   $n$ is an integer representing the number of trials
-   $k$ is an integer representing the number of mutually exclusive outcomes
-   $\mathbf{p} = [p_{1},\ldots,p_{k}]$ is a vector with real numbered probabilities $0\leq p_i\leq 1$ for each outcome ($1\leq i \leq k$).

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X_{i}) = np_{i}$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X_{i}) = np_{i}(1-p_{i})$ |  |
| **PMF** | $\mathbb{P}(X_{1}=x_{1},\ldots,X_{k}=x_{k})=\dfrac{n!}{x_{1}!\ldots x_{k}!}p^{x_{1}}\ldots p^{x_{k}}$ |  |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X_{i}) = np_{i}$ -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X_{i}) = np_{i}(1-p_{i})$ -->

<!-- **PMF:** $\mathbb{P}(X_{1}=x_{i},...,X_{k}=x_{k})=\frac{n!}{x_{i}!...x_{k}!}p^{x_{1}}...p^{x_{k}}$ -->

**Example:** There is a candy jar consisting of 5 red candies, 3 blue candies, and 7 yellow candies.

-   The probability of drawing a red candy is $\dfrac{1}{3}$.

-   The probability of drawing a blue candy is $\dfrac{1}{5}$.

-   The probability of drawing a yellow candy is $\dfrac{7}{15}$

You draw 3 candies from the jar, replacing as you go along. This can be expressed as $X \sim M\left(3,\frac{1}{3},\frac{1}{5},\frac{7}{15}\right)$. It means 3 trials are conducted, where $p_{1}=\frac{1}{3}$, $p_{2}=\frac{1}{5}$, and $p_{3}=\frac{7}{15}$ (and $k=3$).

## Poisson distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The Poisson distribution is used when a specific event occurs at some rate $\lambda$, and you are counting $X$, the number of times this event occurs in some interval.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Poisson}(\lambda)$ or $X \sim \textrm{Pois}(\lambda)$.

**Parameter:** $\lambda$ is the integer number of times an event occurs within a specific period of time.

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \lambda$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \lambda$ |  |
| **PMF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{\lambda^xe^{-\lambda}}{x!}$ |  |
| **CDF** | $\displaystyle\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=\sum^{\lfloor x \rfloor}_{i=1}\frac{\lambda^xe^{-\lambda}}{x!}$ | $\lfloor x \rfloor$ the floor function |

```{=html}
<script>
/* =========================================================
   POISSON DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {
  "use strict";

  const root = document.querySelector(".poisson-calculator");
  if (!root) return;

  const lambdaInput = root.querySelector("#poisson-lambda");
  const xInput = root.querySelector("#poisson-x");
  const lowerInput = root.querySelector("#poisson-lower");
  const upperInput = root.querySelector("#poisson-upper");

  const lambdaDisplay = root.querySelector("#poisson-lambda-value");
  const xDisplay = root.querySelector("#poisson-x-value");
  const lowerDisplay = root.querySelector("#poisson-lower-value");
  const upperDisplay = root.querySelector("#poisson-upper-value");

  const title = root.querySelector("#poisson-plot-title");
  const result = root.querySelector("#poisson-result");
  const xContainer = root.querySelector("#poisson-x-container");
  const betweenContainer = root.querySelector("#poisson-between-container");
  const canvas = root.querySelector("#poisson-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  /* Stable recurrence avoids factorial overflow. */

  function poissonProbabilities(maximumK, lambda) {
    const probabilities = new Array(maximumK + 1);
    probabilities[0] = Math.exp(-lambda);

    for (let k = 1; k <= maximumK; k++) {
      probabilities[k] = probabilities[k - 1] * lambda / k;
    }

    return probabilities;
  }

  function poissonCDF(k, lambda) {
    if (k < 0) return 0;

    k = Math.floor(k);
    let term = Math.exp(-lambda);
    let total = term;

    for (let i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
      term *= lambda / i;
      total += term;
    }

    return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, total));
  }

  function getProbabilityType() {
    const selected = root.querySelector(
      'input[name="poisson-prob-type"]:checked'
    );
    return selected ? selected.value : "less";
  }

  function updateRanges() {
    const lambda = parseFloat(lambdaInput.value);
    const suggestedMaximum = Math.min(
      100,
      Math.max(15, Math.ceil(lambda + 6 * Math.sqrt(lambda) + 3))
    );

    [xInput, lowerInput, upperInput].forEach(function(input) {
      input.max = suggestedMaximum;
      if (parseInt(input.value, 10) > suggestedMaximum) {
        input.value = suggestedMaximum;
      }
    });

    if (parseInt(upperInput.value, 10) < parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
  }

  function updateDisplay() {
    updateRanges();

    const lambda = parseFloat(lambdaInput.value);
    lambdaDisplay.textContent = lambda.toFixed(1);
    xDisplay.textContent = parseInt(xInput.value, 10);
    lowerDisplay.textContent = parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10);
    upperDisplay.textContent = parseInt(upperInput.value, 10);
    title.textContent = `Poisson(λ = ${lambda.toFixed(1)})`;
  }

  function calculateProbability() {
    const lambda = parseFloat(lambdaInput.value);
    const x = parseInt(xInput.value, 10);
    let lower = parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10);
    let upper = parseInt(upperInput.value, 10);
    const type = getProbabilityType();

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper;
      upperDisplay.textContent = upper;
    }

    let probability;

    if (type === "less") {
      probability = poissonCDF(x, lambda);
      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${x}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if (type === "greater") {
      probability = x <= 0 ? 1 : 1 - poissonCDF(x - 1, lambda);
      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${x}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      probability = poissonCDF(upper, lambda) - poissonCDF(lower - 1, lambda);
      result.textContent =
        `P(${lower} ≤ X ≤ ${upper}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }

    probability = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probability));
    return { type, x, lower, upper, probability, lambda };
  }

  function getPlotMaximum(lambda, selected) {
    const selectedMaximum = selected.type === "between"
      ? selected.upper
      : selected.x;

    return Math.min(
      100,
      Math.max(
        12,
        selectedMaximum + 3,
        Math.ceil(lambda + 5 * Math.sqrt(lambda) + 2)
      )
    );
  }

  function drawChart() {
    const selected = calculateProbability();
    const lambda = selected.lambda;
    const maximumK = getPlotMaximum(lambda, selected);
    const probabilities = poissonProbabilities(maximumK, lambda);
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 58, right: 20, top: 25, bottom: 52 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const maximumY = Math.max(...probabilities) * 1.12;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    function xScale(k) {
      return padding.left + ((k + 0.5) / (maximumK + 1)) * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      return padding.top + chartHeight - (value / maximumY) * chartHeight;
    }

    /* GRID AND Y-AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const probability = (i / 4) * maximumY;
      const y = yScale(probability);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(probability.toFixed(2), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    /* BARS */

    const availableWidth = chartWidth / (maximumK + 1);
    const barWidth = Math.max(2, Math.min(34, availableWidth * 0.72));

    for (let k = 0; k <= maximumK; k++) {
      const probability = probabilities[k];
      const barHeight = (probability / maximumY) * chartHeight;
      const x = xScale(k) - barWidth / 2;
      const y = padding.top + chartHeight - barHeight;
      let highlighted = false;

      if (selected.type === "less") {
        highlighted = k <= selected.x;
      } else if (selected.type === "greater") {
        highlighted = k >= selected.x;
      } else {
        highlighted = k >= selected.lower && k <= selected.upper;
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = highlighted ? "#3F6BB6" : "#d3d3d3";
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);
    }

    /* AXES */

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    /* X-AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    const interval = maximumK <= 15 ? 1 : maximumK <= 30 ? 2 : 5;

    for (let k = 0; k <= maximumK; k++) {
      if (k === 0 || k === maximumK || k % interval === 0) {
        ctx.fillText(k, xScale(k), padding.top + chartHeight + 20);
      }
    }

    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(
      "number of events (X)",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("probability mass function", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `Poisson probability mass function with mean rate ${lambda.toFixed(1)}. ` +
      `The selected probability is ${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`
    );
  }

  function updateVisibility() {
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    xContainer.hidden = type === "between";
    betweenContainer.hidden = type !== "between";
  }

  function update() {
    updateVisibility();
    updateDisplay();
    drawChart();
  }

  lambdaInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  xInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  lowerInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10) > parseInt(upperInput.value, 10)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  upperInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseInt(upperInput.value, 10) < parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10)) {
      lowerInput.value = upperInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  root.querySelectorAll('input[name="poisson-prob-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(drawChart, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

```

**Example:** Customers enter Cantor’s Confectionery at an average rate of 20 people per hour, and you want to see the likelihood that $X$ number of customers walks in. This can be expressed as $X \sim \textrm{Pois}(20)$.

## Negative binomial distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The negative binomial distribution is often used to handle over-dispersed data, which means the variance exceeds the mean. It can serve as an alternative to the Poisson distribution, as the Poisson distribution assumes that the mean is equal to the variance. $X$ represents the number of trials required to reach the targeted number of successes $r$.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{NB}(r,p)$

**Parameters:** Two numbers $r,p$ where:

-   $r$ is an integer representing the targeted number of successes,
-   $p$ is a real number representing the probability of success in a single trial (where $0 \le p \le 1$).

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{r(1-p)}{p}$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{r(1-p)}{p^2}$ |  |
| **PMF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{(x+r-1)!}{(r-1)!x!}(1-p)^xp^r$ |  |
| **CDF** | $\displaystyle\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=\sum^{x}_{i=1}\frac{(x+r-1)!}{(r-1)!x!}(1-p)^xp^r$ |  |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{r(1-p)}{p}$. -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{r(1-p)}{p^2}$. -->

<!-- **PMF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{(x+r-1)!}{(r-1)!x!}(1-p)^xp^r$ -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\sum^{x}_{i=1}\frac{(x+r-1)!}{(r-1)!x!}(1-p)^xp^r$ -->

```{=html}
          <label for="rInput">
            Number of successes required (r):
          </label>

          <input
            type="number"
            id="rInput"
            class="number-input"
            value="5"
            min="1"
            step="1"
          >

        </div>


        <div class="slider-group">

          <label for="pInput">
            Probability of success (p):
            <span class="slider-value" id="pValue">0.50</span>
          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="pInput"
            min="0.01"
            max="0.99"
            value="0.50"
            step="0.01"
          >

        </div>


        <hr>


        <div>

          <strong>Probability to calculate:</strong>

          <div class="radio-group">

            <label class="radio-option">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="probType"
                value="less"
                checked
              >
              P(X ≤ x)
            </label>


            <label class="radio-option">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="probType"
                value="greater"
              >
              P(X ≥ x)
            </label>


            <label class="radio-option">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="probType"
                value="between"
              >
              P(x ≤ X ≤ y)
            </label>

          </div>

        </div>


        <!-- SINGLE X -->

        <div
          id="singleX"
          class="slider-group"
        >

          <label for="xInput">
            x value:
            <span
              class="slider-value"
              id="xValue"
            >5</span>
          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="xInput"
            min="0"
            max="30"
            value="5"
            step="1"
          >

        </div>


        <!-- BETWEEN -->

        <div
          id="betweenInputs"
          style="display:none;"
        >

          <div class="slider-group">

            <label for="lowerInput">
              Lower bound (x):
              <span
                class="slider-value"
                id="lowerValue"
              >2</span>
            </label>

            <input
              type="range"
              id="lowerInput"
              min="0"
              max="30"
              value="2"
              step="1"
            >

          </div>


          <div class="slider-group">

            <label for="upperInput">
              Upper bound (y):
              <span
                class="slider-value"
                id="upperValue"
              >7</span>
            </label>

            <input
              type="range"
              id="upperInput"
              min="0"
              max="30"
              value="7"
              step="1"
            >

          </div>

        </div>


        <div class="help-text">

          The negative binomial distribution models the number of
          failures observed before achieving a specified number of
          successes.

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- PLOT CARD -->

    <div class="card">

      <div class="card-header">
        Negative binomial distribution plot
      </div>

      <div class="card-body">

        <div
          class="plot-title"
          id="plotTitle"
        >
          NegBin(r = 5, p = 0.50)
        </div>

        <canvas id="plot"></canvas>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>


  <!-- =====================================================
       RESULTS CARD
       ===================================================== -->

  <div class="card">

    <div class="card-header">
      Results
    </div>

    <div class="card-body">

      <div
        class="result"
        id="result"
      >
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>

</div>


<script>

/* =========================================================
   ELEMENTS
   ========================================================= */

const rInput = document.getElementById("rInput");
const pInput = document.getElementById("pInput");

const xInput = document.getElementById("xInput");
const lowerInput = document.getElementById("lowerInput");
const upperInput = document.getElementById("upperInput");

const pValue = document.getElementById("pValue");

const xValue = document.getElementById("xValue");
const lowerValue = document.getElementById("lowerValue");
const upperValue = document.getElementById("upperValue");

const singleX = document.getElementById("singleX");
const betweenInputs = document.getElementById("betweenInputs");

const plotTitle = document.getElementById("plotTitle");
const result = document.getElementById("result");

const canvas = document.getElementById("plot");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");


/* =========================================================
   NEGATIVE BINOMIAL PROBABILITY MASS FUNCTION
   =========================================================

   X = number of failures before r successes

   P(X=x) =
   choose(x+r-1, x) * p^r * (1-p)^x

   We calculate this using logarithms to avoid numerical
   overflow for larger values.
   ========================================================= */

function logGamma(z) {

  const coefficients = [
    676.5203681218851,
    -1259.1392167224028,
    771.32342877765313,
    -176.61502916214059,
    12.507343278686905,
    -0.13857109526572012,
    9.9843695780195716e-6,
    1.5056327351493116e-7
  ];

  if (z < 0.5) {

    return Math.log(Math.PI)
      - Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI * z))
      - logGamma(1 - z);

  }

  z -= 1;

  let x = 0.99999999999980993;

  for (let i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
    x += coefficients[i] / (z + i + 1);
  }

  const t = z + coefficients.length - 0.5;

  return (
    0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI)
    + (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t)
    - t
    + Math.log(x)
  );
}


function logChoose(n, k) {

  if (k < 0 || k > n) {
    return -Infinity;
  }

  return (
    logGamma(n + 1)
    - logGamma(k + 1)
    - logGamma(n - k + 1)
  );

}


function negBinPMF(x, r, p) {

  if (x < 0 || !Number.isInteger(x)) {
    return 0;
  }

  const logProb =
    logChoose(x + r - 1, x)
    + r * Math.log(p)
    + x * Math.log(1 - p);

  return Math.exp(logProb);

}


/* =========================================================
   DISTRIBUTION RANGE
   ========================================================= */

function getMaxX(r, p) {

  /*
   * Choose a useful plotting range.

   * Mean = r(1-p)/p
   * SD   = sqrt(r(1-p))/p

   We show approximately mean + 4 SD,
   with sensible minimum and maximum limits.
  */

  const mean = r * (1 - p) / p;
  const sd = Math.sqrt(r * (1 - p)) / p;

  let maxX = Math.ceil(mean + 4 * sd);

  maxX = Math.max(maxX, 10);
  maxX = Math.min(maxX, 100);

  return maxX;
}


/* =========================================================
   UPDATE X/Y SLIDER RANGES
   ========================================================= */

function updateSliderRanges() {

  const r = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.round(Number(rInput.value))
  );

  const p = Number(pInput.value);

  const maxX = getMaxX(r, p);

  xInput.max = maxX;
  lowerInput.max = maxX;
  upperInput.max = maxX;

  /*
   * Keep existing values inside the new range.
   */

  if (Number(xInput.value) > maxX) {
    xInput.value = maxX;
  }

  if (Number(lowerInput.value) > maxX) {
    lowerInput.value = maxX;
  }

  if (Number(upperInput.value) > maxX) {
    upperInput.value = maxX;
  }

}


/* =========================================================
   CUMULATIVE PROBABILITY
   ========================================================= */

function cumulativeProbability(x, r, p) {

  if (x < 0) {
    return 0;
  }

  let sum = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i <= x; i++) {

    sum += negBinPMF(i, r, p);

  }

  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, sum));

}


/* =========================================================
   GET CURRENT PROBABILITY
   ========================================================= */

function calculateProbability() {

  const r = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.round(Number(rInput.value))
  );

  const p = Number(pInput.value);

  const type =
    document.querySelector(
      'input[name="probType"]:checked'
    ).value;


  if (type === "less") {

    const x = Math.round(Number(xInput.value));

    const prob =
      cumulativeProbability(x, r, p);

    return {
      probability: prob,
      type: type,
      x: x
    };

  }


  if (type === "greater") {

    const x = Math.round(Number(xInput.value));

    /*
     * P(X >= x)
     *
     * = 1 - P(X <= x-1)
     */

    let prob;

    if (x === 0) {
      prob = 1;
    } else {
      prob =
        1 -
        cumulativeProbability(x - 1, r, p);
    }

    return {
      probability: prob,
      type: type,
      x: x
    };

  }


  if (type === "between") {

    let lower =
      Math.round(Number(lowerInput.value));

    let upper =
      Math.round(Number(upperInput.value));

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper;
    }

    /*
     * P(lower <= X <= upper)
     */

    const upperProb =
      cumulativeProbability(upper, r, p);

    const lowerProb =
      lower === 0
        ? 0
        : cumulativeProbability(lower - 1, r, p);

    const prob =
      upperProb - lowerProb;

    return {
      probability: prob,
      type: type,
      lower: lower,
      upper: upper
    };

  }

}


/* =========================================================
   UPDATE RESULT
   ========================================================= */

function updateResult() {

  const r =
    Math.max(
      1,
      Math.round(Number(rInput.value))
    );

  const p =
    Number(pInput.value);

  const res =
    calculateProbability();

  const prob =
    res.probability;


  if (res.type === "less") {

    result.innerHTML =
      `<span class="result-main">
        P(X ≤ ${res.x}) =
      </span>
      <span class="result-probability">
        ${prob.toFixed(6)}
      </span>
      or ${(
        prob * 100
      ).toFixed(4)}%`;

  }


  else if (res.type === "greater") {

    result.innerHTML =
      `<span class="result-main">
        P(X ≥ ${res.x}) =
      </span>
      <span class="result-probability">
        ${prob.toFixed(6)}
      </span>
      <br>
      or ${(
        prob * 100
      ).toFixed(4)}%`;

  }


  else {

    result.innerHTML =
      `<span class="result-main">
        P(${res.lower} ≤ X ≤ ${res.upper}) =
      </span>
      <span class="result-probability">
        ${prob.toFixed(6)}
      </span>
      <br>
      or ${(
        prob * 100
      ).toFixed(4)}%`;

  }

}


/* =========================================================
   DRAW PLOT
   ========================================================= */

function drawPlot() {

  const r =
    Math.max(
      1,
      Math.round(Number(rInput.value))
    );

  const p =
    Number(pInput.value);

  const maxX =
    getMaxX(r, p);

  const res =
    calculateProbability();


  /*
   * Canvas sizing
   */

  const rect =
    canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

  const dpr =
    window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

  canvas.width =
    rect.width * dpr;

  canvas.height =
    rect.height * dpr;

  ctx.setTransform(
    dpr,
    0,
    0,
    dpr,
    0,
    0
  );


  const width =
    rect.width;

  const height =
    rect.height;


  /*
   * Plot margins
   */

  const margin = {
    left: 55,
    right: 20,
    top: 25,
    bottom: 50
  };


  const plotWidth =
    width -
    margin.left -
    margin.right;

  const plotHeight =
    height -
    margin.top -
    margin.bottom;


  /*
   * Clear
   */

  ctx.clearRect(
    0,
    0,
    width,
    height
  );


  /*
   * Distribution
   */

  const values = [];

  let maxProb = 0;

  for (let x = 0; x <= maxX; x++) {

    const prob =
      negBinPMF(x, r, p);

    values.push(prob);

    maxProb =
      Math.max(
        maxProb,
        prob
      );

  }


  /*
   * Scales
   */

  function xScale(x) {

    return (
      margin.left +
      (x / maxX) *
      plotWidth
    );

  }


  function yScale(y) {

    return (
      margin.top +
      plotHeight -
      (y / maxProb) *
      plotHeight *
      0.9
    );

  }


  /*
   * Axes
   */

  ctx.strokeStyle = "#888";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;

  ctx.beginPath();

  ctx.moveTo(
    margin.left,
    margin.top
  );

  ctx.lineTo(
    margin.left,
    margin.top + plotHeight
  );

  ctx.lineTo(
    margin.left + plotWidth,
    margin.top + plotHeight
  );

  ctx.stroke();


  /*
   * Bars
   */

  const barWidth =
    Math.max(
      2,
      (plotWidth / (maxX + 1)) * 0.72
    );


  values.forEach(
    (prob, x) => {

      const barX =
        xScale(x) -
        barWidth / 2;

      const barY =
        yScale(prob);

      const barHeight =
        margin.top +
        plotHeight -
        barY;


      /*
       * Determine whether this bar
       * is inside selected probability.
       */

      let highlighted = false;


      if (res.type === "less") {

        highlighted =
          x <= res.x;

      }


      else if (res.type === "greater") {

        highlighted =
          x >= res.x;

      }


      else if (res.type === "between") {

        highlighted =
          x >= res.lower &&
          x <= res.upper;

      }


      /*
       * Draw bar
       */

      ctx.fillStyle =
        highlighted
          ? "#3F68B6"
          : "#d8d8d8";

      ctx.fillRect(
        barX,
        barY,
        barWidth,
        barHeight
      );


      /*
       * Border
       */

      ctx.strokeStyle =
        "#888";

      ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;

      ctx.strokeRect(
        barX,
        barY,
        barWidth,
        barHeight
      );

    }
  );


  /*
   * X axis labels
   *
   * Avoid displaying every label when
   * there are lots of bars.
   */

  ctx.fillStyle = "#555";
  ctx.font = "12px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";

  let labelStep = 1;

  if (maxX > 40) {
    labelStep = 5;
  } else if (maxX > 25) {
    labelStep = 2;
  }

  for (
    let x = 0;
    x <= maxX;
    x += labelStep
  ) {

    ctx.fillText(
      x,
      xScale(x),
      margin.top +
      plotHeight +
      20
    );

  }


  /*
   * Axis labels
   */

  ctx.font =
    "13px Arial";

  ctx.fillStyle =
    "#444";

  ctx.textAlign =
    "center";

  ctx.fillText(
    "number of failures (X)",
    margin.left +
    plotWidth / 2,
    height - 10
  );


  /*
   * Rotated Y axis label
   */

  ctx.save();

  ctx.translate(
    15,
    margin.top +
    plotHeight / 2
  );

  ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);

  ctx.textAlign =
    "center";

  ctx.fillText(
    "probability mass function",
    0,
    0
  );

  ctx.restore();

}


/* =========================================================
   UPDATE EVERYTHING
   ========================================================= */

function updateCalculator() {

  let r =
    Math.max(
      1,
      Math.round(Number(rInput.value))
    );

  /*
   * Ensure r input is an integer.
   */

  rInput.value = r;


  const p =
    Number(pInput.value);


  /*
   * Display p.
   */

  pValue.textContent =
    p.toFixed(2);


  /*
   * Update slider ranges.
   */

  updateSliderRanges();


  /*
   * Display x values.
   */

  xValue.textContent =
    xInput.value;

  lowerValue.textContent =
    lowerInput.value;

  upperValue.textContent =
    upperInput.value;


  /*
   * Keep lower <= upper.
   */

  if (
    Number(upperInput.value) <
    Number(lowerInput.value)
  ) {

    upperInput.value =
      lowerInput.value;

    upperValue.textContent =
      upperInput.value;

  }


  /*
   * Update title.
   */

  plotTitle.textContent =
    `NegBin(r = ${r}, p = ${p.toFixed(2)})`;


  /*
   * Update results.
   */

  updateResult();


  /*
   * Redraw plot.
   */

  drawPlot();

}


/* =========================================================
   RADIO BUTTON DISPLAY
   ========================================================= */

function updateProbabilityInputs() {

  const type =
    document.querySelector(
      'input[name="probType"]:checked'
    ).value;


  if (
    type === "less" ||
    type === "greater"
  ) {

    singleX.style.display =
      "block";

    betweenInputs.style.display =
      "none";

  }

  else {

    singleX.style.display =
      "none";

    betweenInputs.style.display =
      "block";

  }


  updateCalculator();

}


/* =========================================================
   EVENT LISTENERS
   ========================================================= */

rInput.addEventListener(
  "input",
  updateCalculator
);

pInput.addEventListener(
  "input",
  updateCalculator
);

xInput.addEventListener(
  "input",
  updateCalculator
);

lowerInput.addEventListener(
  "input",
  updateCalculator
);

upperInput.addEventListener(
  "input",
  updateCalculator
);


document
  .querySelectorAll(
    'input[name="probType"]'
  )
  .forEach(
    radio => {

      radio.addEventListener(
        "change",
        updateProbabilityInputs
      );

    }
  );


/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE REDRAW
   ========================================================= */

window.addEventListener(
  "resize",
  () => {

    drawPlot();

  }
);


/* =========================================================
   INITIALISE
   ========================================================= */

updateProbabilityInputs();

</script>

</body>
</html>

```

**Example:** You flip a coin multiple times, and the probability of getting ‘heads’ is $0.5$. You decide to stop flipping the coin once you get $3$ ‘heads’; these do not have to be consecutive. Taking ‘heads’ as a success, this can be expressed as $X \sim \textrm{NB}(3,0.5)$. It means the probability of success is $0.5$, and you will stop conducting trials after you reach $3$ successes.

## Geometric distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The geometric distribution is used to count $X$, the number of Bernoulli trials until a successful outcome is reached.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Geometric}(p)$

**Parameter:** $p$ is the real number representing the probability of success in a single trial (where $0 \le p \le 1$).

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{1}{p}$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{1-p}{p^2}$ |  |
| **PMF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=(1-p)^{k-1}p$ |  |
| **CDF** | $\displaystyle\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=\begin{cases} 1-(1-p)^x & \textsf{if } x\geq0 \\0 & \textsf{if } x<0\end{cases}$ |  |

<!-- **Mean and Expected Value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{1}{p}$. -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{1-p}{p^2}$ -->

<!-- **PMF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=(1-p)^{k-1}p$ -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\begin{cases} 1-(1-p)^x & \textsf{if } x\geq0 \\0 & \textsf{if } x<0\end{cases}$ -->

```{=html}
<body>

<div class="distribution-calculator geometric-calculator">

  <div class="calculator-row">

    <!-- PARAMETERS CARD -->
    <div class="calculator-card parameters-card">

      <div class="calculator-card-header">
        Parameters
      </div>

      <div class="calculator-card-body">

        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="geometric-p">
            Probability of success (p):

          <input
            type="range"
            id="geometric-p"
            min="0.01"
            max="1"
            value="0.30"
            step="0.01"
            class="distribution-slider">

          <div class="slider-value" id="geometric-p-value">
            0.30
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="distribution-note">
          X is the number of trials up to and including the first success.
          Therefore, X can take the values 1, 2, 3, ...
        </div>

        <hr>

        <fieldset class="probability-options">

          <legend>
            Probability to calculate:
          </legend>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="geometric-prob-type"
              value="less"
              checked>
            <span>P(X &le; x)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="geometric-prob-type"
              value="greater">
            <span>P(X &ge; x)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="geometric-prob-type"
              value="between">
            <span>P(a &le; X &le; b)</span>
          </label>

        </fieldset>

        <!-- SINGLE X VALUE -->
        <div id="geometric-x-container" class="conditional-input">

          <label for="geometric-x">
            x value:
          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="geometric-x"
            min="1"
            max="30"
            value="4"
            step="1"
            class="distribution-slider">

          <div class="slider-value" id="geometric-x-value">
            4
          </div>

        </div>

        <!-- LOWER / UPPER VALUES -->
        <div id="geometric-between-container" class="conditional-input" hidden>

          <label for="geometric-lower">
            Lower bound (a):
          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="geometric-lower"
            min="1"
            max="30"
            value="2"
            step="1"
            class="distribution-slider">

          <div class="slider-value" id="geometric-lower-value">
            2
          </div>

          <label for="geometric-upper" class="upper-label">

          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="geometric-upper"
            min="1"

</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   GEOMETRIC DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   X = NUMBER OF TRIALS UNTIL THE FIRST SUCCESS
   ========================================================= */

(function() {
  "use strict";

  const root = document.querySelector(".geometric-calculator");
  if (!root) return;

  const pInput = root.querySelector("#geometric-p");
  const xInput = root.querySelector("#geometric-x");
  const lowerInput = root.querySelector("#geometric-lower");
  const upperInput = root.querySelector("#geometric-upper");

  const pDisplay = root.querySelector("#geometric-p-value");
  const xDisplay = root.querySelector("#geometric-x-value");
  const lowerDisplay = root.querySelector("#geometric-lower-value");
  const upperDisplay = root.querySelector("#geometric-upper-value");

  const title = root.querySelector("#geometric-plot-title");
  const result = root.querySelector("#geometric-result");
  const xContainer = root.querySelector("#geometric-x-container");
  const betweenContainer = root.querySelector("#geometric-between-container");
  const canvas = root.querySelector("#geometric-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function geometricPMF(k, p) {
    if (k < 1 || !Number.isInteger(k)) return 0;
    return Math.pow(1 - p, k - 1) * p;
  }

  function geometricCDF(k, p) {
    if (k < 1) return 0;
    return 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, Math.floor(k));
  }

  function getProbabilityType() {
    const selected = root.querySelector(
      'input[name="geometric-prob-type"]:checked'
    );

    return selected ? selected.value : "less";
  }

  function updateDisplay() {
    const p = parseFloat(pInput.value);
    const x = parseInt(xInput.value, 10);
    const lower = parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10);
    const upper = parseInt(upperInput.value, 10);

    pDisplay.textContent = p.toFixed(2);
    xDisplay.textContent = x;
    lowerDisplay.textContent = lower;
    upperDisplay.textContent = upper;
    title.textContent = `Geometric(p = ${p.toFixed(2)})`;
  }

  function calculateProbability() {
    const p = parseFloat(pInput.value);
    const x = parseInt(xInput.value, 10);
    let lower = parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10);
    let upper = parseInt(upperInput.value, 10);
    const type = getProbabilityType();

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper;
      upperDisplay.textContent = upper;
    }

    let probability;

    if (type === "less") {
      probability = geometricCDF(x, p);

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${x}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if (type === "greater") {
      probability = Math.pow(1 - p, x - 1);

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${x}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      probability =
        geometricCDF(upper, p) -
        geometricCDF(lower - 1, p);

      result.textContent =
        `P(${lower} ≤ X ≤ ${upper}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} or ` +
        `${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }

    probability = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probability));

    return { type, x, lower, upper, probability, p };
  }

  function getPlotMaximum(p, selected) {
    let tailLimit;

    if (p === 1) {
      tailLimit = 5;
    } else {
      tailLimit = Math.ceil(
        Math.log(0.005) / Math.log(1 - p)
      );
    }

    const selectedMaximum = selected.type === "between"
      ? selected.upper
      : selected.x;

    return Math.max(
      10,
      Math.min(50, Math.max(tailLimit, selectedMaximum + 3))
    );
  }

  function drawChart() {
    const selected = calculateProbability();
    const p = selected.p;
    const maximumK = getPlotMaximum(p, selected);
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 58, right: 20, top: 25, bottom: 52 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const probabilities = [];

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    for (let k = 1; k <= maximumK; k++) {
      probabilities.push(geometricPMF(k, p));
    }

    const maximumY = Math.max(...probabilities) * 1.12;

    function xScale(k) {
      return padding.left +
        ((k - 0.5) / maximumK) * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      return padding.top + chartHeight -
        (value / maximumY) * chartHeight;
    }

    /* GRID AND Y LABELS */

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const probability = (i / 4) * maximumY;
      const y = yScale(probability);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(probability.toFixed(2), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    /* BARS */

    const availableBarWidth = chartWidth / maximumK;
    const barWidth = Math.max(2, Math.min(34, availableBarWidth * 0.72));

    for (let k = 1; k <= maximumK; k++) {
      const probability = probabilities[k - 1];
      const barHeight = (probability / maximumY) * chartHeight;
      const x = xScale(k) - barWidth / 2;
      const y = padding.top + chartHeight - barHeight;
      let highlighted = false;

      if (selected.type === "less") {
        highlighted = k <= selected.x;
      } else if (selected.type === "greater") {
        highlighted = k >= selected.x;
      } else {
        highlighted = k >= selected.lower && k <= selected.upper;
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = highlighted ? "#3F6BB6" : "#d3d3d3";
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);
    }

    /* AXES */

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    /* X-AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    const labelInterval = maximumK <= 15
      ? 1
      : maximumK <= 30
        ? 2
        : 5;

    for (let k = 1; k <= maximumK; k++) {
      if (k === 1 || k === maximumK || k % labelInterval === 0) {
        ctx.fillText(
          k,
          xScale(k),
          padding.top + chartHeight + 20
        );
      }
    }

    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(
      "trial of first success (X)",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    /* Y-AXIS TITLE */

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("probability mass function", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `Geometric distribution probability mass function with success ` +
      `probability ${p.toFixed(2)}. The selected probability is ` +
      `${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`
    );
  }

  function updateVisibility() {
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    xContainer.hidden = type === "between";
    betweenContainer.hidden = type !== "between";
  }

  function update() {
    updateVisibility();
    updateDisplay();
    drawChart();
  }

  pInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  xInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  lowerInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10) > parseInt(upperInput.value, 10)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  upperInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseInt(upperInput.value, 10) < parseInt(lowerInput.value, 10)) {
      lowerInput.value = upperInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  root.querySelectorAll('input[name="geometric-prob-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(drawChart, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>


```

**Example:** You flip a coin multiple times, and the probability of getting ‘heads’ is $0.5$. You decide to stop flipping the coin once you get a ‘heads’. Taking ‘heads’ as a success, this can be expressed as $X \sim \textrm{Geometric}(0.5)$. It means the probability of success is $0.5$, and you will stop conducting trials after you reach a success.

# Continuous random variables

## Uniform distribution (continuous) {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The continuous uniform distribution is used when all continuous values $x$ in the interval $a$ to $b$ are equally likely. The random variable $X$ represents the outcome.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Uniform}(a,b)$ or $X \sim U(a,b)$.

**Parameters:** Two real numbers $a,b$, where

-   $a$ is the minimum value of an outcome,

-   $b$ is the maximum value of an outcome.

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{a+b}{2}$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{(b-a)^2}{12}$ |  |
| **PDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\begin{cases} \dfrac{1}{b-a} & \textsf{if } a \leq x \leq b \\0 & \textsf{otherwise}\end{cases}$ |  |
| **CDF** | $\displaystyle\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=\begin{cases} 0 & \textsf{if } x< a \\\dfrac{x-a}{b-a} & \textsf{if } a\leq x\leq b \\1 & \textsf{if } x>b \end{cases}$ |  |

<!-- **Mean and Expected Value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{a+b}{2}$. -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{(b-a)^2}{12}.$ -->

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\begin{cases} \dfrac{1}{b-a} & \textsf{if } a \leq x \leq b \\0 & \textsf{otherwise}\end{cases}$ -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)= \begin{cases} 0 & \textsf{if } x< a \\\dfrac{x-a}{b-a} & \textsf{if } a\leq x\leq b \\1 & \textsf{if } x>b \end{cases}$ -->
