```{=html}
<script>
/* =========================================================
   CONTINUOUS UNIFORM DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {
  "use strict";

  const root = document.querySelector(".continuous-uniform-calculator");
  if (!root) return;

  const minimumInput = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-minimum");
  const maximumInput = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-maximum");
  const xInput = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-x");
  const lowerInput = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-lower");
  const upperInput = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-upper");

  const xDisplay = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-x-value");
  const lowerDisplay = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-lower-value");
  const upperDisplay = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-upper-value");

  const error = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-error");
  const title = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-plot-title");
  const result = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-result");
  const xContainer = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-x-container");
  const betweenContainer = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-between-container");
  const canvas = root.querySelector("#continuous-uniform-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function validateParameters() {
    const minimum = Number(minimumInput.value);
    const maximum = Number(maximumInput.value);
    let message = "";

    if (!Number.isFinite(minimum) || !Number.isFinite(maximum)) {
      message = "Enter numerical values for both distribution limits.";
    } else if (maximum <= minimum) {
      message = "The maximum value must be greater than the minimum value.";
    }

    error.textContent = message;
    minimumInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", message ? "true" : "false");
    maximumInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", message ? "true" : "false");

    return message ? null : { minimum, maximum };
  }

  function getProbabilityType() {
    const selected = root.querySelector(
      'input[name="continuous-uniform-prob-type"]:checked'
    );

    return selected ? selected.value : "less";
  }

  function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) {
    return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, value));
  }

  function sliderStep(minimum, maximum) {
    return Math.max(0.001, (maximum - minimum) / 100);
  }

  function formatValue(value) {
    return Number(value).toFixed(2);
  }

  function updateRanges(parameters) {
    const minimum = parameters.minimum;
    const maximum = parameters.maximum;
    const step = sliderStep(minimum, maximum);

    [xInput, lowerInput, upperInput].forEach(function(input) {
      input.min = minimum;
      input.max = maximum;
      input.step = step;

      const current = Number(input.value);

      input.value = Number.isFinite(current)
        ? clamp(current, minimum, maximum)
        : minimum;
    });

    if (Number(upperInput.value) < Number(lowerInput.value)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
  }

  function updateDisplay(parameters) {
    updateRanges(parameters);

    xDisplay.textContent = formatValue(xInput.value);
    lowerDisplay.textContent = formatValue(lowerInput.value);
    upperDisplay.textContent = formatValue(upperInput.value);

    title.textContent =
      `Uniform(a = ${formatValue(parameters.minimum)}, ` +
      `b = ${formatValue(parameters.maximum)})`;
  }

  function uniformCDF(value, minimum, maximum) {
    if (value <= minimum) return 0;
    if (value >= maximum) return 1;
    return (value - minimum) / (maximum - minimum);
  }

  function calculateProbability(parameters) {
    const minimum = parameters.minimum;
    const maximum = parameters.maximum;
    const x = Number(xInput.value);
    let lower = Number(lowerInput.value);
    let upper = Number(upperInput.value);
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    let probability;

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper;
      upperDisplay.textContent = formatValue(upper);
    }

    if (type === "less") {
      probability = uniformCDF(x, minimum, maximum);

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${formatValue(x)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if (type === "greater") {
      probability = 1 - uniformCDF(x, minimum, maximum);

      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${formatValue(x)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      probability =
        uniformCDF(upper, minimum, maximum) -
        uniformCDF(lower, minimum, maximum);

      result.textContent =
        `P(${formatValue(lower)} ≤ X ≤ ${formatValue(upper)}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} or ` +
        `${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }

    probability = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probability));

    return {
      type,
      x,
      lower,
      upper,
      probability,
      minimum,
      maximum
    };
  }

  function drawChart(parameters) {
    const selected = calculateProbability(parameters);
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 62, right: 22, top: 25, bottom: 52 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const range = selected.maximum - selected.minimum;
    const plotMinimum = selected.minimum - range * 0.15;
    const plotMaximum = selected.maximum + range * 0.15;
    const density = 1 / range;
    const maximumY = density * 1.25;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    function xScale(value) {
      return padding.left +
        ((value - plotMinimum) / (plotMaximum - plotMinimum)) * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      return padding.top + chartHeight -
        (value / maximumY) * chartHeight;
    }

    /* GRID AND Y-AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const value = (i / 4) * maximumY;
      const y = yScale(value);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(value.toFixed(2), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    /* UNSELECTED DENSITY AREA */

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(211, 211, 211, 0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(
      xScale(selected.minimum),
      yScale(density),
      xScale(selected.maximum) - xScale(selected.minimum),
      yScale(0) - yScale(density)
    );

    /* SELECTED PROBABILITY AREA */

    let selectedStart;
    let selectedEnd;

    if (selected.type === "less") {
      selectedStart = selected.minimum;
      selectedEnd = selected.x;
    } else if (selected.type === "greater") {
      selectedStart = selected.x;
      selectedEnd = selected.maximum;
    } else {
      selectedStart = selected.lower;
      selectedEnd = selected.upper;
    }

    selectedStart = clamp(
      selectedStart,
      selected.minimum,
      selected.maximum
    );

    selectedEnd = clamp(
      selectedEnd,
      selected.minimum,
      selected.maximum
    );

    if (selectedEnd > selectedStart) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)";
      ctx.fillRect(
        xScale(selectedStart),
        yScale(density),
        xScale(selectedEnd) - xScale(selectedStart),
        yScale(0) - yScale(density)
      );
    }

    /* DENSITY OUTLINE */

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xScale(selected.minimum), yScale(0));
    ctx.lineTo(xScale(selected.minimum), yScale(density));
    ctx.lineTo(xScale(selected.maximum), yScale(density));
    ctx.lineTo(xScale(selected.maximum), yScale(0));
    ctx.stroke();

    /* BOUNDARY LINES */

    function drawBoundary(value) {
      if (value < selected.minimum || value > selected.maximum) return;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(value), yScale(0));
      ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(density));
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (selected.type === "between") {
      drawBoundary(selected.lower);
      drawBoundary(selected.upper);
    } else {
      drawBoundary(selected.x);
    }

    /* AXES */

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    /* X-AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    const tickCount = width < 500 ? 5 : 8;

    for (let i = 0; i <= tickCount; i++) {
      const value = plotMinimum +
        (i / tickCount) * (plotMaximum - plotMinimum);

      ctx.fillText(
        formatValue(value),
        xScale(value),
        padding.top + chartHeight + 20
      );
    }

    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(
      "value of X",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("probability density", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `Continuous uniform probability density from ` +
      `${formatValue(selected.minimum)} to ${formatValue(selected.maximum)}. ` +
      `The density is ${density.toFixed(4)} and the selected probability is ` +
      `${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`
    );
  }

  function updateVisibility() {
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    xContainer.hidden = type === "between";
    betweenContainer.hidden = type !== "between";
  }

  function update() {
    updateVisibility();

    const parameters = validateParameters();

    if (!parameters) {
      result.textContent =
        "Enter valid distribution limits to calculate a probability.";
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      return;
    }

    updateDisplay(parameters);
    drawChart(parameters);
  }

  minimumInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  maximumInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  xInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  lowerInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (Number(lowerInput.value) > Number(upperInput.value)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }

    update();
  });

  upperInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (Number(upperInput.value) < Number(lowerInput.value)) {
      lowerInput.value = upperInput.value;
    }

    update();
  });

  root
    .querySelectorAll('input[name="continuous-uniform-prob-type"]')
    .forEach(function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    });

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(update, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>


```

**Example:**

A machine from Cantor's Confectionery is programmed to chop long candy bars into pieces, each with a length between 30 millimetres to 50 millimetres. Due to variations in the machine, each continuous value between this interval is equally likely. This can be expressed as $X \sim U(30,50)$. It means 30 is the minimum value and 50 is the maximum value, where all continuous values of $X$ for $30 \leq x \leq 50$ are equally likely.

## Normal distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The normal distribution is used to model continuous random variables, which can include any positive or negative real values. The use of this distribution is often justified by the Central Limit Theorem: as the sample size increases, the distribution of sample means will resemble a normal distribution more and more closely.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Normal}(\mu,\sigma^2)$ or $X \sim N(\mu,\sigma^2)$

**Parameters:** Two real numbers $\mu$ and $\sigma^2$.

-   $\mu$ is the centre of the distribution (the mean/expected value).
-   $\sigma^2$ is the measure of how the distribution is spread (the variance).

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \mu$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \sigma^2$ |  |
| **PDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi\sigma^2}}\exp\left({-\dfrac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}}\right)$ | $\exp(y) = e^y$ |
| **CDF** | $\displaystyle\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=\dfrac{1}{2}\left[1+\textrm{erf}\left(\dfrac{x-\mu}{\sigma\sqrt{2}}\right)\right]$ | $\textrm{erf}(x)$ is the error function of $x$ |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \mu$. -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \sigma^2$. -->

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi\sigma^2}}\exp\left({-\dfrac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}}\right)$, where $\exp(y) = e^y$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=\frac{1}{2}\left[1+\textrm{erf}(\dfrac{x-\mu}{\sigma\sqrt{2}})\right]$ where $\textrm{erf}(x)$ is the error function of $x$. -->

```{=html}
  </style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="distribution-calculator normal-calculator">

  <div class="calculator-row">

    <!-- PARAMETERS CARD -->
    <div class="calculator-card parameters-card">
      <div class="calculator-card-header">Parameters</div>

      <div class="calculator-card-body">

        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="normal-mean">Mean (&mu;):</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="normal-mean"
            value="0"

        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="normal-sd">Standard deviation (&sigma;):</label>

            type="number"
            id="normal-sd"

            step="0.1"

        <hr>

        <fieldset class="probability-options">
          <legend>Probability to calculate:</legend>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input type="radio" name="normal-prob-type" value="less" checked>
            <span>P(X &le; x)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input type="radio" name="normal-prob-type" value="greater">
            <span>P(X &ge; x)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input type="radio" name="normal-prob-type" value="between">
            <span>P(a &le; X &le; b)</span>
          </label>
        </fieldset>

        <!-- SINGLE X VALUE -->
        <div id="normal-x-container" class="conditional-input">
          <label for="normal-x">x value:</label>
          <input
            type="range"
            id="normal-x"
            min="-5"
            max="5"
            value="1"
            step="0.1"
            class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="normal-x-value">1.0</div>
        </div>

        <!-- LOWER / UPPER VALUES -->
        <div id="normal-between-container" class="conditional-input" hidden>
          <label for="normal-lower">Lower bound (a):</label>
          <input
            type="range"
            id="normal-lower"
            min="-5"
            max="5"
            value="-1"
            step="0.1"
            class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="normal-lower-value">-1.0</div>

          <label for="normal-upper" class="upper-label">Upper bound (b):</label>
          <input
            type="range"
            id="normal-upper"
            min="-5"
            max="5"
            value="1"
            step="0.1"
            class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="normal-upper-value">1.0</div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PLOT CARD -->
    <div class="calculator-card plot-card">
      <div class="calculator-card-header">Normal distribution plot</div>

      <div class="calculator-card-body">
        <div id="normal-plot-title" class="distribution-plot-title">
          N(&mu; = 0.0, &sigma; = 1.0)
        </div>

        <div class="normal-chart-wrapper">
          <canvas
            id="normal-chart"
            tabindex="0"
            role="img"
            aria-label="Normal distribution probability density function">
          </canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- RESULTS CARD -->
  <div class="calculator-card results-card">
    <div class="calculator-card-header">Results</div>
    <div class="calculator-card-body">
      <div id="normal-result" class="calculation-result" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   NORMAL DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {
  "use strict";

  const root = document.querySelector(".normal-calculator");
  if (!root) return;

  const meanInput = root.querySelector("#normal-mean");
  const sdInput = root.querySelector("#normal-sd");
  const xInput = root.querySelector("#normal-x");
  const lowerInput = root.querySelector("#normal-lower");
  const upperInput = root.querySelector("#normal-upper");

  const xDisplay = root.querySelector("#normal-x-value");
  const lowerDisplay = root.querySelector("#normal-lower-value");
  const upperDisplay = root.querySelector("#normal-upper-value");

  const title = root.querySelector("#normal-plot-title");
  const result = root.querySelector("#normal-result");
  const xContainer = root.querySelector("#normal-x-container");
  const betweenContainer = root.querySelector("#normal-between-container");
  const canvas = root.querySelector("#normal-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function erf(value) {
    const sign = value < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const z = Math.abs(value);
    const a1 = 0.254829592;
    const a2 = -0.284496736;
    const a3 = 1.421413741;
    const a4 = -1.453152027;
    const a5 = 1.061405429;
    const p = 0.3275911;
    const t = 1 / (1 + p * z);

    const y = 1 -
      (((((a5 * t + a4) * t + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t) *
      Math.exp(-z * z);

    return sign * y;
  }

  function normalPDF(value, mean, sd) {
    const z = (value - mean) / sd;
    return Math.exp(-0.5 * z * z) / (sd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
  }

  function normalCDF(value, mean, sd) {
    return 0.5 * (1 + erf((value - mean) / (sd * Math.sqrt(2))));
  }

  function getProbabilityType() {
    const selected = root.querySelector(
      'input[name="normal-prob-type"]:checked'
    );
    return selected ? selected.value : "less";
  }

  function validateParameters() {
    let mean = parseFloat(meanInput.value);
    let sd = parseFloat(sdInput.value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(mean)) {
      mean = 0;
      meanInput.value = 0;
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(sd) || sd <= 0) {
      sd = 0.1;
      sdInput.value = 0.1;
    }

    return { mean, sd };
  }

  function updateSliderRanges(mean, sd) {
    const minimum = mean - 5 * sd;
    const maximum = mean + 5 * sd;
    const step = Math.max(0.01, sd / 10);

    [xInput, lowerInput, upperInput].forEach(function(input) {
      input.min = minimum;
      input.max = maximum;
      input.step = step;
    });

    if (parseFloat(xInput.value) < minimum || parseFloat(xInput.value) > maximum) {
      xInput.value = mean + sd;
    }

    if (parseFloat(lowerInput.value) < minimum || parseFloat(lowerInput.value) > maximum) {
      lowerInput.value = mean - sd;
    }

    if (parseFloat(upperInput.value) < minimum || parseFloat(upperInput.value) > maximum) {
      upperInput.value = mean + sd;
    }
  }

  function formatValue(value) {
    return Number(value).toFixed(2);
  }

  function updateDisplay() {
    const parameters = validateParameters();
    updateSliderRanges(parameters.mean, parameters.sd);

    xDisplay.textContent = formatValue(xInput.value);
    lowerDisplay.textContent = formatValue(lowerInput.value);
    upperDisplay.textContent = formatValue(upperInput.value);

    title.textContent =
      `N(μ = ${parameters.mean.toFixed(2)}, σ = ${parameters.sd.toFixed(2)})`;
  }

  function calculateProbability() {
    const parameters = validateParameters();
    const mean = parameters.mean;
    const sd = parameters.sd;
    const x = parseFloat(xInput.value);
    let lower = parseFloat(lowerInput.value);
    let upper = parseFloat(upperInput.value);
    const type = getProbabilityType();

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper;
      upperDisplay.textContent = formatValue(upper);
    }

    let probability;

    if (type === "less") {
      probability = normalCDF(x, mean, sd);
      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${formatValue(x)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if (type === "greater") {
      probability = 1 - normalCDF(x, mean, sd);
      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${formatValue(x)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      probability =
        normalCDF(upper, mean, sd) -
        normalCDF(lower, mean, sd);

      result.textContent =
        `P(${formatValue(lower)} ≤ X ≤ ${formatValue(upper)}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} or ` +
        `${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }

    probability = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probability));

    return { type, x, lower, upper, probability, mean, sd };
  }

  function drawChart() {
    const selected = calculateProbability();
    const mean = selected.mean;
    const sd = selected.sd;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 62, right: 22, top: 25, bottom: 52 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const minimumX = mean - 4 * sd;
    const maximumX = mean + 4 * sd;
    const maximumY = normalPDF(mean, mean, sd) * 1.12;
    const pointCount = Math.max(600, Math.round(chartWidth * 1.7));

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    function xScale(value) {
      return padding.left +
        ((value - minimumX) / (maximumX - minimumX)) * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      return padding.top + chartHeight -
        (value / maximumY) * chartHeight;
    }

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const density = (i / 4) * maximumY;
      const y = yScale(density);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(density.toFixed(2), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    function fillArea(start, end, colour) {
      const boundedStart = Math.max(minimumX, Math.min(maximumX, start));
      const boundedEnd = Math.max(minimumX, Math.min(maximumX, end));

      if (boundedEnd <= boundedStart) return;

      const count = Math.max(
        2,
        Math.round(
          pointCount * (boundedEnd - boundedStart) /
          (maximumX - minimumX)
        )
      );

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(boundedStart), yScale(0));

      for (let i = 0; i <= count; i++) {
        const value = boundedStart +
          (i / count) * (boundedEnd - boundedStart);
        ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(normalPDF(value, mean, sd)));
      }

      ctx.lineTo(xScale(boundedEnd), yScale(0));
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = colour;
      ctx.fill();
    }

    fillArea(minimumX, maximumX, "rgba(211, 211, 211, 0.55)");

    if (selected.type === "less") {
      fillArea(minimumX, selected.x, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    } else if (selected.type === "greater") {
      fillArea(selected.x, maximumX, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    } else {
      fillArea(selected.lower, selected.upper, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    }

    ctx.beginPath();

    for (let i = 0; i <= pointCount; i++) {
      const value = minimumX +
        (i / pointCount) * (maximumX - minimumX);
      const chartX = xScale(value);
      const chartY = yScale(normalPDF(value, mean, sd));

      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(chartX, chartY);
      else ctx.lineTo(chartX, chartY);
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    function drawBoundary(value) {
      if (value < minimumX || value > maximumX) return;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(value), yScale(0));
      ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(normalPDF(value, mean, sd)));
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (selected.type === "between") {
      drawBoundary(selected.lower);
      drawBoundary(selected.upper);
    } else {
      drawBoundary(selected.x);
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#aaaaaa";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xScale(mean), padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(xScale(mean), padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    const tickCount = width < 500 ? 4 : 8;

    for (let i = 0; i <= tickCount; i++) {
      const value = minimumX +
        (i / tickCount) * (maximumX - minimumX);
      ctx.fillText(
        formatValue(value),
        xScale(value),
        padding.top + chartHeight + 20
      );
    }

    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(
      "value of X",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("probability density", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `Normal distribution plot with mean ${mean.toFixed(2)} and ` +
      `standard deviation ${sd.toFixed(2)}. The selected probability is ` +
      `${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`
    );
  }

  function updateVisibility() {
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    xContainer.hidden = type === "between";
    betweenContainer.hidden = type !== "between";
  }

  function update() {
    updateVisibility();
    updateDisplay();
    drawChart();
  }

  meanInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  sdInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  meanInput.addEventListener("change", update);
  sdInput.addEventListener("change", update);
  xInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  lowerInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseFloat(lowerInput.value) > parseFloat(upperInput.value)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  upperInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseFloat(upperInput.value) < parseFloat(lowerInput.value)) {
      lowerInput.value = upperInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  root.querySelectorAll('input[name="normal-prob-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(drawChart, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
```

**Example:** The lengths of chocolate bars produced by Cantor’s Confectionery follow a normal distribution with a mean of $5.6$ inches and a variance of $1.44$. This can be expressed as $X \sim N(5.6, 1.44)$, meaning the data is normally distributed, centered at $5.6$ with standard deviation $\sqrt{1.44} = 1.2$.

## Lognormal distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The lognormal distribution is used to model continuous random variables with values that are both real and non-negative, wherein the logarithms of these variables follow a normal distribution. That is to say, if the random variable $X$ is lognormally distributed, then the random variable $Y = \ln(X)$ is normally distributed (where $\ln$ is the natural logarithm).

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Lognormal}(\mu,\sigma^2)$

**Parameters:** As with the normal distribution, two numbers $\mu$ and $\sigma^2$ where:

-   $\mu$ is the expected value of the normally distributed random variable $Y = \ln(X)$,
-   $\sigma^2$ is the variance of the normally distributed random variable $Y = \ln(X)$.

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \exp(\mu+\frac{\sigma^2}{2})$ | $\exp(y) = e^y$ |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = [\exp(\sigma^2)-1]\exp(2\mu+\sigma^2)$ | $\exp(y) = e^y$ |
| **PDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{1}{x\sigma\sqrt{2\pi}}\exp\left(-\dfrac{(\ln(x)-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}\right)$ | $\exp(y) = e^y$ |
| **CDF** | $\displaystyle\mathbb{P}(X\leq x)=\dfrac{1}{2}\left[1+\textrm{erf}\left(\dfrac{\ln(x)-\mu}{\sigma\sqrt{2}}\right)\right]$ | $\textrm{erf}(x)$ is the error function of $x$ |

<!-- **Mean and Expected Value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \exp(\mu+\frac{\sigma^2}{2})$ where $\exp(x)=e^x$ -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = [\exp(\sigma^2)-1]\exp(2\mu+\sigma^2)$ where $\exp(x)=e^x$ -->

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{1}{x\sigma\sqrt{2\pi}}\exp\left(-\dfrac{(\ln(x)-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}\right)$ where $\exp(x)=e^x$ and $\ln(x)$ is the natural logarithm of $x$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\dfrac{1}{2}\left[1+\textrm{erf}\left(\dfrac{\ln(x)-\mu}{\sigma\sqrt{2}}\right)\right]$ where $\textrm{erf}(x)$ is the error function of $x$ and $\ln(x)$ is the natural logarithm of $x$. -->

```{=html}
</head>
<body>
<div class="distribution-calculator lognormal-calculator">
  <div class="calculator-row">
    <div class="calculator-card parameters-card">
      <div class="calculator-card-header">Parameters</div>
      <div class="calculator-card-body">
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="lognormal-mu">Location parameter (&mu;):</label>
          <input type="range" id="lognormal-mu" min="-2" max="2" value="0" step="0.1" class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="lognormal-mu-value">0.0</div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="lognormal-sigma">Scale parameter (&sigma;):</label>
          <input type="range" id="lognormal-sigma" min="0.1" max="1.5" value="0.5" step="0.1" class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="lognormal-sigma-value">0.5</div>
        </div>
        <hr>
        <fieldset class="probability-options">
          <legend>Probability to calculate:</legend>
          <label class="radio-option"><input type="radio" name="lognormal-prob-type" value="less" checked><span>P(X &le; x)</span></label>
          <label class="radio-option"><input type="radio" name="lognormal-prob-type" value="greater"><span>P(X &ge; x)</span></label>
          <label class="radio-option"><input type="radio" name="lognormal-prob-type" value="between"><span>P(a &le; X &le; b)</span></label>
        </fieldset>
        <div id="lognormal-x-container" class="conditional-input">
          <label for="lognormal-x">x value:</label>
          <input type="range" id="lognormal-x" min="0" max="15" value="2" step="0.1" class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="lognormal-x-value">2.0</div>
        </div>
        <div id="lognormal-between-container" class="conditional-input" hidden>
          <label for="lognormal-lower">Lower bound (a):</label>
          <input type="range" id="lognormal-lower" min="0" max="15" value="0.5" step="0.1" class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="lognormal-lower-value">0.5</div>
          <label for="lognormal-upper" class="upper-label">Upper bound (b):</label>
          <input type="range" id="lognormal-upper" min="0" max="15" value="2" step="0.1" class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="lognormal-upper-value">2.0</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="calculator-card plot-card">
      <div class="calculator-card-header">Lognormal distribution plot</div>
      <div class="calculator-card-body">
        <div id="lognormal-plot-title" class="distribution-plot-title">Lognormal(&mu; = 0.0, &sigma; = 0.5)</div>
        <div class="lognormal-chart-wrapper">
          <canvas id="lognormal-chart" tabindex="0" role="img" aria-label="Lognormal distribution probability density function"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="calculator-card results-card">
    <div class="calculator-card-header">Results</div>
    <div class="calculator-card-body">
      <div id="lognormal-result" class="calculation-result" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";
  const root = document.querySelector(".lognormal-calculator");
  if (!root) return;
  const q = s => root.querySelector(s);
  const muInput=q("#lognormal-mu"), sigmaInput=q("#lognormal-sigma"), xInput=q("#lognormal-x");
  const lowerInput=q("#lognormal-lower"), upperInput=q("#lognormal-upper");
  const muDisplay=q("#lognormal-mu-value"), sigmaDisplay=q("#lognormal-sigma-value");
  const xDisplay=q("#lognormal-x-value"), lowerDisplay=q("#lognormal-lower-value"), upperDisplay=q("#lognormal-upper-value");
  const title=q("#lognormal-plot-title"), result=q("#lognormal-result");
  const xContainer=q("#lognormal-x-container"), betweenContainer=q("#lognormal-between-container");
  const canvas=q("#lognormal-chart"), ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");

  function erf(v) {
    const sign=v<0?-1:1, z=Math.abs(v), t=1/(1+0.3275911*z);
    const y=1-(((((1.061405429*t-1.453152027)*t+1.421413741)*t-0.284496736)*t+0.254829592)*t)*Math.exp(-z*z);
    return sign*y;
  }
  function normalCDF(z) { return 0.5*(1+erf(z/Math.sqrt(2))); }
  function pdf(v,mu,sigma) {
    if(v<=0||sigma<=0) return 0;
    return Math.exp(-Math.pow(Math.log(v)-mu,2)/(2*sigma*sigma))/(v*sigma*Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI));
  }
  function cdf(v,mu,sigma) { return v<=0?0:normalCDF((Math.log(v)-mu)/sigma); }
  function type() { const e=q('input[name="lognormal-prob-type"]:checked'); return e?e.value:"less"; }

  function display() {
    const mu=+muInput.value, sigma=+sigmaInput.value;
    muDisplay.textContent=mu.toFixed(1); sigmaDisplay.textContent=sigma.toFixed(1);
    xDisplay.textContent=(+xInput.value).toFixed(1);
    lowerDisplay.textContent=(+lowerInput.value).toFixed(1);
    upperDisplay.textContent=(+upperInput.value).toFixed(1);
    title.textContent=`Lognormal(μ = ${mu.toFixed(1)}, σ = ${sigma.toFixed(1)})`;
  }

  function calculate() {
    const mu=+muInput.value, sigma=+sigmaInput.value, x=+xInput.value;
    let lower=+lowerInput.value, upper=+upperInput.value;
    const t=type();
    if(upper<lower){ upper=lower; upperInput.value=upper.toFixed(1); }
    let probability;
    if(t==="less") {
      probability=cdf(x,mu,sigma);
      result.textContent=`P(X ≤ ${x.toFixed(1)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} or ${(probability*100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if(t==="greater") {
      probability=1-cdf(x,mu,sigma);
      result.textContent=`P(X ≥ ${x.toFixed(1)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} or ${(probability*100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      probability=cdf(upper,mu,sigma)-cdf(lower,mu,sigma);
      result.textContent=`P(${lower.toFixed(1)} ≤ X ≤ ${upper.toFixed(1)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} or ${(probability*100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }
    return {type:t,x,lower,upper,probability};
  }

  function draw() {
    const mu=+muInput.value, sigma=+sigmaInput.value, selected=calculate();
    const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); if(!rect.width||!rect.height) return;
    const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
    canvas.width=Math.round(rect.width*dpr); canvas.height=Math.round(rect.height*dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    const width=rect.width,height=rect.height,pad={left:62,right:20,top:25,bottom:50};
    const cw=width-pad.left-pad.right,ch=height-pad.top-pad.bottom;
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
    const chosenMax=selected.type==="between"?selected.upper:selected.x;
    const maxX=Math.max(2,chosenMax*1.2,Math.exp(mu+3.1*sigma));
    const points=Math.max(500,Math.round(cw*1.5)), start=Math.max(maxX/points/4,0.0001);
    let maxY=0;
    for(let i=0;i<=points;i++){const v=start+(i/points)*(maxX-start);maxY=Math.max(maxY,pdf(v,mu,sigma));}
    maxY=Math.max(maxY*1.1,0.01);
    const xs=v=>pad.left+(v/maxX)*cw, ys=v=>pad.top+ch-(v/maxY)*ch;

    ctx.font="12px Arial";ctx.textAlign="right";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
    for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){
      const d=(i/4)*maxY,y=ys(d);ctx.strokeStyle="#e5e5e5";ctx.lineWidth=1;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad.left,y);ctx.lineTo(width-pad.right,y);ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle="#555";ctx.fillText(d.toFixed(2),pad.left-8,y);
    }
    function fillArea(a,b,colour){
      a=Math.max(0,Math.min(maxX,a));b=Math.max(0,Math.min(maxX,b));if(b<=a)return;
      const count=Math.max(2,Math.round(points*(b-a)/maxX));ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(xs(a),ys(0));
      for(let i=0;i<=count;i++){const v=a+(i/count)*(b-a);ctx.lineTo(xs(v),ys(pdf(v,mu,sigma)));}
      ctx.lineTo(xs(b),ys(0));ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=colour;ctx.fill();
    }
    fillArea(0,maxX,"rgba(211,211,211,0.55)");
    if(selected.type==="less")fillArea(0,selected.x,"rgba(63,107,182,0.58)");
    else if(selected.type==="greater")fillArea(selected.x,maxX,"rgba(63,107,182,0.58)");
    else fillArea(selected.lower,selected.upper,"rgba(63,107,182,0.58)");

    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<=points;i++){const v=start+(i/points)*(maxX-start),px=xs(v),py=ys(pdf(v,mu,sigma));i?ctx.lineTo(px,py):ctx.moveTo(px,py);}
    ctx.strokeStyle="#274f91";ctx.lineWidth=2.5;ctx.stroke();
    function boundary(v){if(v<0||v>maxX)return;ctx.save();ctx.setLineDash([5,4]);ctx.strokeStyle="#274f91";ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(xs(v),ys(0));ctx.lineTo(xs(v),ys(pdf(v,mu,sigma)));ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
    selected.type==="between"?(boundary(selected.lower),boundary(selected.upper)):boundary(selected.x);

    ctx.strokeStyle="#777";ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad.left,pad.top);ctx.lineTo(pad.left,pad.top+ch);ctx.lineTo(width-pad.right,pad.top+ch);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle="#333";ctx.font="12px Arial";ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
    const ticks=width<500?5:8;
    for(let i=0;i<=ticks;i++){const v=(i/ticks)*maxX;ctx.fillText(v.toFixed(1),xs(v),pad.top+ch+20);}
    ctx.font="13px Arial";ctx.fillText("value of X",pad.left+cw/2,height-8);
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(15,pad.top+ch/2);ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.fillText("probability density",0,0);ctx.restore();
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-label",`Lognormal density plot. Selected probability ${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`);
  }

  function update(){const t=type();xContainer.hidden=t==="between";betweenContainer.hidden=t!=="between";display();draw();}
  [muInput,sigmaInput,xInput].forEach(e=>e.addEventListener("input",update));
  lowerInput.addEventListener("input",()=>{if(+lowerInput.value>+upperInput.value)upperInput.value=lowerInput.value;update();});
  upperInput.addEventListener("input",()=>{if(+upperInput.value<+lowerInput.value)lowerInput.value=upperInput.value;update();});
  root.querySelectorAll('input[name="lognormal-prob-type"]').forEach(e=>e.addEventListener("change",update));
  let timer;window.addEventListener("resize",()=>{clearTimeout(timer);timer=setTimeout(draw,80);});
  update();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```

**Example:** The logarithms of Cantor’s Confectionery’s stock prices follow a normal distribution. The mean of the stock prices’ natural logarithms is $8.01$, whereas the variance of the stock prices’ natural logarithms is $3$. This can be expressed as $X \sim \textrm{Lognormal}(8.01, 3)$, meaning the logarithm of the location parameter is $8.01$ and the logarithm of scale parameter is $3$.

## Exponential distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The exponential distribution is used when $X$ is the waiting time before a certain event occurs. It is similar to the geometric distribution, but the exponential distribution uses a continuous waiting time instead of the integer number of trials.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Exponential}(\lambda)$ or $X \sim \textrm{Exp}(\lambda)$

**Parameter:** An integer $\lambda$, representing number of times an event occurs within a specific period of time.

| Quantity     | Value                                    | Notes |
|:-------------|:-----------------------------------------|:------|
| **Mean**     | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \frac{1}{\lambda}$      |       |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \frac{1}{\lambda^2}$    |       |
| **PDF**      | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}$ |       |
| **CDF**      | $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=1-e^{-\lambda x}$  |       |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \frac{1}{\lambda}$. -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \frac{1}{\lambda^2}$. -->

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=1-e^{-\lambda x}$. -->

```{=html}
<script>

/* =========================================================
   EXPONENTIAL DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {

  "use strict";


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     ELEMENTS
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const lambdaInput =
    document.getElementById("exponential-lambda");

  const xInput =
    document.getElementById("exponential-x");

  const lowerInput =
    document.getElementById("exponential-lower");

  const upperInput =
    document.getElementById("exponential-upper");

  const lambdaDisplay =
    document.getElementById("exponential-lambda-value");

  const xDisplay =
    document.getElementById("exponential-x-value");

  const lowerDisplay =
    document.getElementById("exponential-lower-value");

  const upperDisplay =
    document.getElementById("exponential-upper-value");

  const meanDisplay =
    document.getElementById("exponential-mean");

  const standardDeviationDisplay =
    document.getElementById(
      "exponential-standard-deviation"
    );

  const title =
    document.getElementById("exponential-plot-title");

  const result =
    document.getElementById("exponential-result");

  const xContainer =
    document.getElementById("exponential-x-container");

  const betweenContainer =
    document.getElementById(
      "exponential-between-container"
    );

  const canvas =
    document.getElementById("exponential-chart");

  const ctx =
    canvas.getContext("2d");


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     EXPONENTIAL PDF
     f(x) = lambda * exp(-lambda * x)
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function exponentialPDF(x, lambda) {

    if (x < 0) {
      return 0;
    }

    return lambda * Math.exp(-lambda * x);

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     EXPONENTIAL CDF
     F(x) = 1 - exp(-lambda * x)
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function exponentialCDF(x, lambda) {

    if (x <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }

    return 1 - Math.exp(-lambda * x);

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     SURVIVAL FUNCTION
     P(X >= x) = exp(-lambda * x)
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function exponentialSurvival(x, lambda) {

    if (x <= 0) {
      return 1;
    }

    return Math.exp(-lambda * x);

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CURRENT PROBABILITY TYPE
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function getProbabilityType() {

    const selected =
      document.querySelector(
        'input[name="exponential-prob-type"]:checked'
      );

    return selected
      ? selected.value
      : "less";

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     NUMBER FORMATTING
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function formatInputValue(value) {

    return Number(value).toFixed(1);

  }


  function formatProbability(value) {

    const boundedValue =
      Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));

    return boundedValue.toFixed(4);

  }


  function formatPercentage(value) {

    const boundedValue =
      Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));

    return (boundedValue * 100).toFixed(2) + "%";

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     UPDATE DISPLAY
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function updateDisplay() {

    const lambda =
      parseFloat(lambdaInput.value);

    const x =
      parseFloat(xInput.value);

    const lower =
      parseFloat(lowerInput.value);

    const upper =
      parseFloat(upperInput.value);

    lambdaDisplay.textContent =
      lambda.toFixed(2);

    xDisplay.textContent =
      formatInputValue(x);

    lowerDisplay.textContent =
      formatInputValue(lower);

    upperDisplay.textContent =
      formatInputValue(upper);

    meanDisplay.textContent =
      (1 / lambda).toFixed(3);

    standardDeviationDisplay.textContent =
      (1 / (lambda*lambda)).toFixed(3);

    title.textContent =
      `Exp(\u03BB = ${lambda.toFixed(2)})`;

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CALCULATE RESULT
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function calculateProbability() {

    const lambda =
      parseFloat(lambdaInput.value);

    const x =
      parseFloat(xInput.value);

    let lower =
      parseFloat(lowerInput.value);

    let upper =
      parseFloat(upperInput.value);

    const type =
      getProbabilityType();


    if (upper < lower) {

      upper = lower;

      upperInput.value =
        upper.toFixed(1);

      upperDisplay.textContent =
        formatInputValue(upper);

    }


    let probability = 0;


    if (type === "less") {

      probability =
        exponentialCDF(x, lambda);

      result.textContent =
        `P(X \u2264 ${formatInputValue(x)}) = ` +
        `${formatProbability(probability)} ` +
        `or ${formatPercentage(probability)}`;

    }


    else if (type === "greater") {

      probability =
        exponentialSurvival(x, lambda);

      result.textContent =
        `P(X \u2265 ${formatInputValue(x)}) = ` +
        `${formatProbability(probability)} ` +
        `or ${formatPercentage(probability)}`;

    }


    else {

      probability =
        exponentialCDF(upper, lambda) -
        exponentialCDF(lower, lambda);

      result.textContent =
        `P(${formatInputValue(lower)} \u2264 X \u2264 ` +
        `${formatInputValue(upper)}) = ` +
        `${formatProbability(probability)} ` +
        `or ${formatPercentage(probability)}`;

    }


    return {
      type,
      x,
      lower,
      upper,
      probability
    };

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CHOOSE A PLOT LIMIT
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function getPlotMaximum(lambda, probabilityResult) {

    /*
      The theoretical support is x >= 0 and has no upper
      limit. The plotted range therefore uses:

      1. A high quantile of the distribution
      2. The currently selected values
      3. A small amount of extra space
    */

    const highQuantile =
      -Math.log(0.005) / lambda;

    let selectedMaximum;

    if (probabilityResult.type === "between") {

      selectedMaximum =
        probabilityResult.upper;

    } else {

      selectedMaximum =
        probabilityResult.x;

    }

    const requiredMaximum =
      Math.max(
        highQuantile,
        selectedMaximum * 1.2,
        1
      );

    /*
      Keep the plot within the range covered by the
      sliders, while still allowing a useful minimum.
    */

    return Math.min(
      12,
      Math.max(2, requiredMaximum)
    );

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     DETERMINE WHETHER X IS SELECTED
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function isSelected(x, probabilityResult) {

    const tolerance = 1e-9;

    if (probabilityResult.type === "less") {

      return (
        x <= probabilityResult.x + tolerance
      );

    }


    if (probabilityResult.type === "greater") {

      return (
        x >= probabilityResult.x - tolerance
      );

    }


    return (
      x >= probabilityResult.lower - tolerance &&
      x <= probabilityResult.upper + tolerance
    );

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     DRAW CHART
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function drawChart() {

    const lambda =
      parseFloat(lambdaInput.value);

    const probabilityResult =
      calculateProbability();

    const rect =
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const dpr =
      window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

    canvas.width =
      Math.round(rect.width * dpr);

    canvas.height =
      Math.round(rect.height * dpr);

    ctx.setTransform(
      dpr,
      0,
      0,
      dpr,
      0,
      0
    );


    const width =
      rect.width;

    const height =
      rect.height;


    ctx.clearRect(
      0,
      0,
      width,
      height
    );


    const padding = {
      left: 62,
      right: 22,
      top: 25,
      bottom: 52
    };


    const chartWidth =
      width -
      padding.left -
      padding.right;

    const chartHeight =
      height -
      padding.top -
      padding.bottom;


    const maximumX =
      getPlotMaximum(
        lambda,
        probabilityResult
      );

    const maximumY =
      lambda * 1.08;


    function xScale(value) {

      return (
        padding.left +
        (value / maximumX) *
        chartWidth
      );

    }


    function yScale(value) {

      return (
        padding.top +
        chartHeight -
        (value / maximumY) *
        chartHeight
      );

    }


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       GRID AND Y-AXIS LABELS
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    ctx.font =
      "12px Arial";

    ctx.textAlign =
      "right";

    ctx.textBaseline =
      "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {

      const probability =
        (i / 4) * maximumY;

      const y =
        yScale(probability);

      ctx.strokeStyle =
        "#e5e5e5";

      ctx.lineWidth = 1;

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.moveTo(
        padding.left,
        y
      );

      ctx.lineTo(
        width - padding.right,
        y
      );

      ctx.stroke();


      ctx.fillStyle =
        "#555555";

      ctx.fillText(
        probability.toFixed(2),
        padding.left - 8,
        y
      );

    }


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       UNSELECTED AREA
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    const pointCount =
      Math.max(400, Math.round(chartWidth * 1.5));

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.moveTo(
      xScale(0),
      yScale(0)
    );

    for (let i = 0; i <= pointCount; i++) {

      const x =
        (i / pointCount) *
        maximumX;

      const y =
        exponentialPDF(x, lambda);

      ctx.lineTo(
        xScale(x),
        yScale(y)
      );

    }

    ctx.lineTo(
      xScale(maximumX),
      yScale(0)
    );

    ctx.closePath();

    ctx.fillStyle =
      "rgba(211, 211, 211, 0.55)";

    ctx.fill();


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       SELECTED AREA
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    let selectedStart;
    let selectedEnd;


    if (probabilityResult.type === "less") {

      selectedStart = 0;

      selectedEnd =
        Math.min(
          maximumX,
          probabilityResult.x
        );

    }


    else if (probabilityResult.type === "greater") {

      selectedStart =
        Math.min(
          maximumX,
          probabilityResult.x
        );

      selectedEnd =
        maximumX;

    }


    else {

      selectedStart =
        Math.min(
          maximumX,
          probabilityResult.lower
        );

      selectedEnd =
        Math.min(
          maximumX,
          probabilityResult.upper
        );

    }


    if (selectedEnd >= selectedStart) {

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.moveTo(
        xScale(selectedStart),
        yScale(0)
      );

      const selectedPointCount =
        Math.max(
          2,
          Math.round(
            pointCount *
            (
              (selectedEnd - selectedStart) /
              maximumX
            )
          )
        );


      for (
        let i = 0;
        i <= selectedPointCount;
        i++
      ) {

        const x =
          selectedStart +
          (i / selectedPointCount) *
          (selectedEnd - selectedStart);

        const y =
          exponentialPDF(x, lambda);

        ctx.lineTo(
          xScale(x),
          yScale(y)
        );

      }


      ctx.lineTo(
        xScale(selectedEnd),
        yScale(0)
      );

      ctx.closePath();

      ctx.fillStyle =
        "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)";

      ctx.fill();

    }


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       DENSITY CURVE
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    ctx.beginPath();

    for (let i = 0; i <= pointCount; i++) {

      const x =
        (i / pointCount) *
        maximumX;

      const y =
        exponentialPDF(x, lambda);

      if (i === 0) {

        ctx.moveTo(
          xScale(x),
          yScale(y)
        );

      } else {

        ctx.lineTo(
          xScale(x),
          yScale(y)
        );

      }

    }

    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "#274f91";

    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;

    ctx.stroke();


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       BOUNDARY LINES
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    function drawBoundary(value) {

      if (value < 0 || value > maximumX) {
        return;
      }

      ctx.save();

      ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);

      ctx.strokeStyle =
        "#274f91";

      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.moveTo(
        xScale(value),
        yScale(0)
      );

      ctx.lineTo(
        xScale(value),
        yScale(
          exponentialPDF(value, lambda)
        )
      );

      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.restore();

    }


    if (probabilityResult.type === "between") {

      drawBoundary(
        probabilityResult.lower
      );

      drawBoundary(
        probabilityResult.upper
      );

    } else {

      drawBoundary(
        probabilityResult.x
      );

    }


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       AXES
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "#777777";

    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.moveTo(
      padding.left,
      padding.top
    );

    ctx.lineTo(
      padding.left,
      padding.top + chartHeight
    );

    ctx.lineTo(
      width - padding.right,
      padding.top + chartHeight
    );

    ctx.stroke();


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       X-AXIS LABELS
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    ctx.fillStyle =
      "#333333";

    ctx.font =
      "12px Arial";

    ctx.textAlign =
      "center";

    ctx.textBaseline =
      "alphabetic";

    const tickCount =
      width < 500 ? 5 : 8;


    for (let i = 0; i <= tickCount; i++) {

      const value =
        (i / tickCount) *
        maximumX;

      const x =
        xScale(value);

      ctx.fillText(
        value.toFixed(1),
        x,
        padding.top +
        chartHeight +
        20
      );

    }


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       X-AXIS TITLE
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    ctx.font =
      "13px Arial";

    ctx.fillText(
      "value of X",
      padding.left +
      chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       Y-AXIS TITLE
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    ctx.save();

    ctx.translate(
      15,
      padding.top +
      chartHeight / 2
    );

    ctx.rotate(
      -Math.PI / 2
    );

    ctx.textAlign =
      "center";

    ctx.fillText(
      "probability density",
      0,
      0
    );

    ctx.restore();


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       ACCESSIBLE CANVAS DESCRIPTION
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    let canvasDescription;

    if (probabilityResult.type === "less") {

      canvasDescription =
        `Exponential probability density plot with rate ` +
        `${lambda.toFixed(2)}. The area from zero to ` +
        `${formatInputValue(probabilityResult.x)} is highlighted.`;

    }

    else if (probabilityResult.type === "greater") {

      canvasDescription =
        `Exponential probability density plot with rate ` +
        `${lambda.toFixed(2)}. The area greater than ` +
        `${formatInputValue(probabilityResult.x)} is highlighted.`;

    }

    else {

      canvasDescription =
        `Exponential probability density plot with rate ` +
        `${lambda.toFixed(2)}. The area between ` +
        `${formatInputValue(probabilityResult.lower)} and ` +
        `${formatInputValue(probabilityResult.upper)} is highlighted.`;

    }

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      canvasDescription
    );

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     VISIBILITY
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function updateVisibility() {

    const type =
      getProbabilityType();

    if (
      type === "less" ||
      type === "greater"
    ) {

      xContainer.hidden = false;

      betweenContainer.hidden = true;

    } else {

      xContainer.hidden = true;

      betweenContainer.hidden = false;

    }

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     MASTER UPDATE
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function update() {

    updateVisibility();

    updateDisplay();

    drawChart();

  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     EVENT LISTENERS
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  lambdaInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );

  xInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    update
  );


  lowerInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    function() {

      if (
        parseFloat(upperInput.value) <
        parseFloat(lowerInput.value)
      ) {

        upperInput.value =
          lowerInput.value;

      }

      update();

    }
  );


  upperInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    function() {

      if (
        parseFloat(upperInput.value) <
        parseFloat(lowerInput.value)
      ) {

        lowerInput.value =
          upperInput.value;

      }

      update();

    }
  );


  document
    .querySelectorAll(
      'input[name="exponential-prob-type"]'
    )
    .forEach(function(radio) {

      radio.addEventListener(
        "change",
        update
      );

    });


  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener(
    "resize",
    function() {

      window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);

      resizeTimer =
        window.setTimeout(
          drawChart,
          80
        );

    }
  );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     INITIALISE
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  update();

})();

</script>

```

**Example:** Customers enter Cantor’s Confectionery at an average rate of 20 people per hour, and the time distance between each visit can be modelled by an exponential distribution. This can be expressed as $X \sim \textrm{Exp}(20)$.

## Gamma distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The gamma distribution generalizes the exponential distribution, allowing for greater or lesser variance. It is used to model positive continuous random variables that have skewed distributions.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Gamma}(\alpha,\theta)$ or $X \sim \textrm{Gam}(\alpha,\theta)$

**Parameters:** Two real numbers $\alpha$ and $\theta$, which are related to the mean $\mu$ and variance $\sigma^2$:

-   $\alpha = \frac{\mu^2}{\sigma^2}$ (shape parameter)
-   $\theta=\frac{\sigma^2}{\mu}$ (scale parameter)

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \alpha\theta$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \alpha\theta^2$ |  |
| **PDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{x^{\alpha-1}\exp\left(-\frac{x}{\theta}\right)}{\Gamma(\alpha)\theta^{\alpha}}$ | $\Gamma(x)$ the gamma function of $x$ |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\dfrac{\textrm{Gam}\left(\alpha,\frac{x}{\theta}\right)}{\Gamma(\alpha)}$ | $\textrm{Gam}(\alpha,\theta)$ is the PDF of the gamma distribution |

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{x^{\alpha-1}\exp\left(-\frac{x}{\theta}\right)}{\Gamma(\alpha)\theta^{\alpha}}$ where $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function of $x$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)}\textrm{Gam}(\alpha,\frac{x}{\theta})$ where $\textrm{Gam}(\alpha,\theta)$ is the PDF of the gamma distribution for parameters $\alpha$ and $\theta$. -->

Arial';ctx.fillText('X',pad.l+cw/2,h-8);ctx.save();ctx.translate(15,pad.t+ch/2);ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);ctx.fillText('Probability density',0,0);ctx.restore();const text=`Gamma distribution with shape ${p.a.toFixed(2)} and scale ${p.theta.toFixed(2)}.`;canvas.setAttribute('aria-label',text);description.textContent=text}
```{=html}
  function update(){secondLabel.textContent=parameterisation.value==='scale'?'Scale (θ):':'Rate (β):';singleContainer.hidden=type()==='between';betweenContainer.hidden=type()!=='between';const p=parameters();if(!p){result.textContent='Enter valid distribution parameters.';ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);return}const max=updateRanges(p),t=type(),x=+xInput.value,lo=+lowerInput.value,hi=+upperInput.value;let prob,label;if(t==='less'){prob=cdf(x,p.a,p.theta);label=`P(X ≤ ${x.toFixed(2)})`}else if(t==='greater'){prob=1-cdf(x,p.a,p.theta);label=`P(X ≥ ${x.toFixed(2)})`}else{prob=cdf(hi,p.a,p.theta)-cdf(lo,p.a,p.theta);label=`P(${lo.toFixed(2)} ≤ X ≤ ${hi.toFixed(2)})`}prob=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,prob));xValue.textContent=x.toFixed(2);lowerValue.textContent=lo.toFixed(2);upperValue.textContent=hi.toFixed(2);const symbol=parameterisation.value==='scale'?'θ':'β';title.textContent=`Gamma(α = ${p.a.toFixed(2)}, ${symbol} = ${p.v.toFixed(2)})`;result.textContent=`${label} = ${prob.toFixed(6)} (${(prob*100).toFixed(2)}%)`;const mean=p.a*p.theta,variance=p.a*p.theta*p.theta;meanOut.textContent=mean.toFixed(3);varianceOut.textContent=variance.toFixed(3);sdOut.textContent=Math.sqrt(variance).toFixed(3);modeOut.textContent=p.a>=1?((p.a-1)*p.theta).toFixed(3):'0 (boundary)';draw(p,max,{t,x,lo,hi,prob})}
  lowerInput.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(+lowerInput.value>+upperInput.value)upperInput.value=lowerInput.value;update()});upperInput.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(+upperInput.value<+lowerInput.value)lowerInput.value=upperInput.value;update()});[shapeInput,secondInput,xInput,parameterisation].forEach(i=>i.addEventListener('input',update));app.querySelectorAll('input[name="gdc-probability-type"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener('change',update));let timer;window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);timer=setTimeout(update,80)});update();

```

**Example:** You collect historical data on the time to failure of a machine from Cantor’s Confectionery. The mean is 83 days and the variance is 50.3. You can then use this to estimate the shape and scale parameters of the gamma distribution:

-   $\alpha = \frac{83^2}{50.3} = 136.958250497 \approx 137$

-   $\theta = \frac{50.3}{83} = 0.60602409638 \approx 0.61$

The distribution can be expressed as $X \sim \textrm{Gam}(137,0.61)$, where the shape parameter is 137 and the scale parameter is 0.61.

## Beta distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The beta distribution is used to model the distribution of *probabilities* or proportions. Hence, the random variable $0 \leq X \leq 1$.

**Notation:** $X \sim \textrm{Beta}(\alpha,\beta)$

**Parameters:** Two positive real numbers $\alpha,\beta$, which are shape parameters. These can be specified as follows in terms of $n$ and $k$ where $n$ is the number of Bernoulli trials and $k$ is the number of successes:

-   $\alpha = k + 1$
-   $\beta = n - k + 1$

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{\alpha}{\alpha+\beta}$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{\alpha\beta}{(\alpha+\beta)^2(\alpha+\beta+1)}$ |  |
| **PDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{x^{\alpha-1}(1-x)^{\beta-1}}{\textrm{B}(\alpha,\beta)}$ | $\textrm{B}(x,y)$ is the beta function |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=I_{x}(\alpha,\beta)$ | $I_{x}(a,b)$ is the regularized incomplete beta function |

 

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \frac{\alpha}{\alpha+\beta}$ -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \frac{\alpha\beta}{(\alpha+\beta)^2(\alpha+\beta+1)}$ -->

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\frac{x^{\alpha-1}(1-x)^{\beta-1}}{\textrm{B}(\alpha,\beta)}$ where $\textrm{B}(x,y)$ is the beta function of $x$ and $y$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=I_{x}(\alpha,\beta)$ where $I_{x}(a,b)$ is the regularized incomplete beta function for $a$ and $b$ with $x$ being the upper bound for integration. -->

```{=html}
<body>

        </div>

          <label for="beta-lower">Lower bound (a):</label>
          <input
            type="range"
            id="beta-lower"
            min="0"
            max="1"
            value="0.2"
            step="0.01"
            class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="beta-lower-value">0.20</div>

          <label for="beta-upper" class="upper-label">Upper bound (b):</label>
          <input
            type="range"
            id="beta-upper"
            min="0"
            max="1"
            value="0.7"
            step="0.01"
            class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="beta-upper-value">0.70</div>

      <div class="calculator-card-header">Beta distribution plot</div>

          Beta(&alpha; = 2.0, &beta; = 5.0)

    </div>
```
