</div>

<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";

  const root = document.querySelector(".beta-calculator");
  if (!root) return;

  const alphaInput = root.querySelector("#beta-alpha");
  const betaInput = root.querySelector("#beta-beta");
  const xInput = root.querySelector("#beta-x");
  const lowerInput = root.querySelector("#beta-lower");
  const upperInput = root.querySelector("#beta-upper");

  const alphaDisplay = root.querySelector("#beta-alpha-value");
  const betaDisplay = root.querySelector("#beta-beta-value");
  const xDisplay = root.querySelector("#beta-x-value");
  const lowerDisplay = root.querySelector("#beta-lower-value");
  const upperDisplay = root.querySelector("#beta-upper-value");

  const title = root.querySelector("#beta-plot-title");
  const result = root.querySelector("#beta-result");
  const xContainer = root.querySelector("#beta-x-container");
  const betweenContainer = root.querySelector("#beta-between-container");
  const canvas = root.querySelector("#beta-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function logGamma(z) {
    const coefficients = [
      676.5203681218851,
      -1259.1392167224028,
      771.32342877765313,
      -176.61502916214059,
      12.507343278686905,
      -0.13857109526572012,
      9.9843695780195716e-6,
      1.5056327351493116e-7
    ];

    if (z < 0.5) {
      return Math.log(Math.PI) -
        Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI * z)) -
        logGamma(1 - z);
    }

    z -= 1;
    let total = 0.99999999999980993;

    for (let i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
      total += coefficients[i] / (z + i + 1);
    }

    const t = z + coefficients.length - 0.5;

    return 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) +
      (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) - t + Math.log(total);
  }

  function betaContinuedFraction(a, b, x) {
    const maxIterations = 200;
    const epsilon = 3e-14;
    const tiny = 1e-300;
    const qab = a + b;
    const qap = a + 1;
    const qam = a - 1;

    let c = 1;
    let d = 1 - qab * x / qap;
    if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
    d = 1 / d;
    let h = d;

    for (let m = 1; m <= maxIterations; m++) {
      const m2 = 2 * m;
      let aa = m * (b - m) * x /
        ((qam + m2) * (a + m2));

      d = 1 + aa * d;
      if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
      c = 1 + aa / c;
      if (Math.abs(c) < tiny) c = tiny;
      d = 1 / d;
      h *= d * c;

      aa = -(a + m) * (qab + m) * x /
        ((a + m2) * (qap + m2));

      d = 1 + aa * d;
      if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
      c = 1 + aa / c;
      if (Math.abs(c) < tiny) c = tiny;
      d = 1 / d;

      const delta = d * c;
      h *= delta;

      if (Math.abs(delta - 1) < epsilon) break;
    }

    return h;
  }

  function regularizedIncompleteBeta(x, a, b) {
    if (x <= 0) return 0;
    if (x >= 1) return 1;

    const logarithmicTerm =
      logGamma(a + b) - logGamma(a) - logGamma(b) +
      a * Math.log(x) + b * Math.log(1 - x);

    const front = Math.exp(logarithmicTerm);

    if (x < (a + 1) / (a + b + 2)) {
      return front * betaContinuedFraction(a, b, x) / a;
    }

    return 1 - front * betaContinuedFraction(b, a, 1 - x) / b;
  }

  function betaPDF(value, alpha, beta) {
    if (value <= 0 || value >= 1) return 0;

    return Math.exp(
      (alpha - 1) * Math.log(value) +
      (beta - 1) * Math.log(1 - value) -
      logGamma(alpha) - logGamma(beta) +
      logGamma(alpha + beta)
    );
  }

  function betaCDF(value, alpha, beta) {
    return regularizedIncompleteBeta(value, alpha, beta);
  }

  function getProbabilityType() {
    const selected = root.querySelector(
      'input[name="beta-prob-type"]:checked'
    );
    return selected ? selected.value : "less";
  }

  function formatValue(value) {
    return Number(value).toFixed(2);
  }

  function updateDisplay() {
    const alpha = parseFloat(alphaInput.value);
    const beta = parseFloat(betaInput.value);

    alphaDisplay.textContent = alpha.toFixed(1);
    betaDisplay.textContent = beta.toFixed(1);
    xDisplay.textContent = formatValue(xInput.value);
    lowerDisplay.textContent = formatValue(lowerInput.value);
    upperDisplay.textContent = formatValue(upperInput.value);

    title.textContent =
      `Beta(α = ${alpha.toFixed(1)}, β = ${beta.toFixed(1)})`;
  }

  function calculateProbability() {
    const alpha = parseFloat(alphaInput.value);
    const beta = parseFloat(betaInput.value);
    const x = parseFloat(xInput.value);
    let lower = parseFloat(lowerInput.value);
    let upper = parseFloat(upperInput.value);
    const type = getProbabilityType();

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper;
      upperDisplay.textContent = formatValue(upper);
    }

    let probability;

    if (type === "less") {
      probability = betaCDF(x, alpha, beta);
      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${formatValue(x)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if (type === "greater") {
      probability = 1 - betaCDF(x, alpha, beta);
      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${formatValue(x)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      probability =
        betaCDF(upper, alpha, beta) -
        betaCDF(lower, alpha, beta);

      result.textContent =
        `P(${formatValue(lower)} ≤ X ≤ ${formatValue(upper)}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} or ` +
        `${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }

    probability = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probability));

    return { type, x, lower, upper, probability, alpha, beta };
  }

  function drawChart() {
    const selected = calculateProbability();
    const alpha = selected.alpha;
    const beta = selected.beta;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 58, right: 20, top: 25, bottom: 50 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const pointCount = 700;
    const epsilon = 0.001;
    const points = [];
    let maximumY = 0;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    for (let i = 0; i <= pointCount; i++) {
      const value = epsilon +
        (i / pointCount) * (1 - 2 * epsilon);
      const density = betaPDF(value, alpha, beta);

      if (Number.isFinite(density)) {
        points.push({ value, density });
        maximumY = Math.max(maximumY, density);
      }
    }

    maximumY = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(25, maximumY * 1.08));

    function xScale(value) {
      return padding.left + value * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      const bounded = Math.min(value, maximumY);
      return padding.top + chartHeight -
        (bounded / maximumY) * chartHeight;
    }

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const density = (i / 4) * maximumY;
      const y = yScale(density);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(density.toFixed(1), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    function fillArea(start, end, colour) {
      const boundedStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, start));
      const boundedEnd = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, end));
      if (boundedEnd <= boundedStart) return;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(boundedStart), yScale(0));

      let hasPoint = false;

      points.forEach(function(point) {
        if (point.value >= boundedStart && point.value <= boundedEnd) {
          ctx.lineTo(xScale(point.value), yScale(point.density));
          hasPoint = true;
        }
      });

      if (!hasPoint) return;

      ctx.lineTo(xScale(boundedEnd), yScale(0));
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = colour;
      ctx.fill();
    }

    fillArea(0, 1, "rgba(211, 211, 211, 0.55)");

    if (selected.type === "less") {
      fillArea(0, selected.x, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    } else if (selected.type === "greater") {
      fillArea(selected.x, 1, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    } else {
      fillArea(selected.lower, selected.upper, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    }

    ctx.beginPath();

    points.forEach(function(point, index) {
      const chartX = xScale(point.value);
      const chartY = yScale(point.density);

      if (index === 0) ctx.moveTo(chartX, chartY);
      else ctx.lineTo(chartX, chartY);
    });

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    function drawBoundary(value) {
      if (value < 0 || value > 1) return;

      const density = value === 0 || value === 1
        ? 0
        : betaPDF(value, alpha, beta);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(value), yScale(0));
      ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(density));
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (selected.type === "between") {
      drawBoundary(selected.lower);
      drawBoundary(selected.upper);
    } else {
      drawBoundary(selected.x);
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
      const value = i / 5;
      ctx.fillText(
        value.toFixed(1),
        xScale(value),
        padding.top + chartHeight + 20
      );
    }

    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(
      "value of X",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("probability density", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `Beta probability density plot with alpha ${alpha.toFixed(1)} and ` +
      `beta ${beta.toFixed(1)}. The selected probability is ` +
      `${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`
    );
  }

  function updateVisibility() {
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    xContainer.hidden = type === "between";
    betweenContainer.hidden = type !== "between";
  }

  function update() {
    updateVisibility();
    updateDisplay();
    drawChart();
  }

  alphaInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  betaInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  xInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  lowerInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseFloat(lowerInput.value) > parseFloat(upperInput.value)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  upperInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseFloat(upperInput.value) < parseFloat(lowerInput.value)) {
      lowerInput.value = upperInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  root.querySelectorAll('input[name="beta-prob-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(drawChart, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>


```

**Example:** Cantor’s Confectionery is visited by 10 customers, and 6 of them purchase something from the store. Taking the buying customers as successes and the total visiting customers as number of trials, there would be 6 successes, allowing you to find the following parameters:

-   $\alpha = 6 + 1 = 7$

-   $\beta = 10 - 6 + 1 = 5$

Then the distribution of the probabilities of a customer purchasing from Cantor’s Confectionery can be expressed as $X \sim \textrm{Beta}(7,5)$, meaning the first shape parameter is 7 and the second shape parameter is 5.

## χ^2 distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The $\chi^2$ distribution is used for hypothesis testing, such as for goodness of fit tests and tests for independence. (See [Guide: Introduction to hypothesis testing](../studyguides/hypothesistesting.qmd) for more.) It is a special case of the gamma distribution, as $\chi^2(k)=\textrm{Gam}(\frac{k}{2},2)$.

**Notation:** $X \sim \chi^2(k)$

**Parameter:** The integer $k$ is the number of degrees of freedom in the sample.

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = k$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = 2k$ |  |
| **PDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{x^{\frac{k}{2}-1}\exp\left({-\frac{x}{2}}\right)}{2^\frac{k}{2}\Gamma\left(\frac{k}{2}\right)}$ | $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma\left(\frac{k}{2}\right)}\textrm{Gam}\left(\frac{k}{2},\frac{x}{2}\right)$ | $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function, $\textrm{Gam}(\alpha,\theta)$ is the PDF of the gamma distribution |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = k$ -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = 2k$ -->

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{x^{\frac{k}{2}-1}\exp\left({-\frac{x}{2}}\right)}{2^\frac{k}{2}\Gamma\left(\frac{k}{2}\right)}$ where $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function of $x$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma\left(\frac{k}{2}\right)}\textrm{Gam}\left(\frac{k}{2},\frac{x}{2}\right)$ where $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function of $x$ and $\textrm{Gam}(\alpha,\theta)$ is the PDF of the gamma distribution for parameters $\alpha$ and $\theta$. -->

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const csdRoot=document.querySelector('.csd-calculator-container');if(!csdRoot)return;
function csdLogGamma(z){const c=[676.5203681218851,-1259.1392167224028,771.32342877765313,-176.61502916214059,12.507343278686905,-.13857109526572012,9.984369578019572e-6,1.5056327351493116e-7];if(z<.5)return Math.log(Math.PI)-Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI*z))-csdLogGamma(1-z);z-=1;let x=.99999999999980993;for(let i=0;i<c.length;i++)x+=c[i]/(z+i+1);const t=z+c.length-.5;return .5*Math.log(2*Math.PI)+(z+.5)*Math.log(t)-t+Math.log(x)}
function csdGammaLowerRegularized(a,x){if(x<0||a<=0)return NaN;if(x===0)return 0;const eps=1e-12,maxIter=10000;if(x<a+1){let sum=1/a,term=sum,ap=a;for(let n=1;n<=maxIter;n++){ap+=1;term*=x/ap;sum+=term;if(Math.abs(term)<Math.abs(sum)*eps)break}return sum*Math.exp(-x+a*Math.log(x)-csdLogGamma(a))}let b=x+1-a,c=1/1e-300,d=1/b,h=d;for(let i=1;i<=maxIter;i++){const an=-i*(i-a);b+=2;d=an*d+b;if(Math.abs(d)<1e-300)d=1e-300;c=b+an/c;if(Math.abs(c)<1e-300)c=1e-300;d=1/d;const delta=d*c;h*=delta;if(Math.abs(delta-1)<eps)break}const q=Math.exp(-x+a*Math.log(x)-csdLogGamma(a))*h;return 1-q}
function csdCDF(x,df){return x<=0?0:csdGammaLowerRegularized(df/2,x/2)}
function csdPDF(x,df){if(x<0)return 0;if(x===0){if(df<2)return Infinity;if(df===2)return .5;return 0}return Math.exp((df/2-1)*Math.log(x)-x/2-(df/2)*Math.log(2)-csdLogGamma(df/2))}
function csdQuantile(prob,df){let low=0,high=Math.max(20,df*2+10);while(csdCDF(high,df)<prob&&high<=1000)high*=2;for(let i=0;i<100;i++){const mid=(low+high)/2;if(csdCDF(mid,df)<prob)low=mid;else high=mid}return(low+high)/2}
const csdDf=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-df'),csdXLess=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-x-less'),csdXGreater=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-x-greater'),csdXLower=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-x-lower'),csdXUpper=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-x-upper'),csdXLessValue=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-x-less-value'),csdXGreaterValue=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-x-greater-value'),csdXLowerValue=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-x-lower-value'),csdXUpperValue=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-x-upper-value'),csdLessControls=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-less-controls'),csdGreaterControls=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-greater-controls'),csdBetweenControls=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-between-controls'),csdPlotTitle=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-plot-title'),csdResult=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-result'),csdError=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-error'),csdDescription=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-plot-description'),csdCanvas=csdRoot.querySelector('#csd-plot'),csdCtx=csdCanvas.getContext('2d');
function csdType(){const selected=csdRoot.querySelector('input[name="csd-prob-type"]:checked');return selected?selected.value:'less'}
function csdValidateDf(){const raw=Number(csdDf.value);let message='';if(!Number.isInteger(raw)||raw<1)message='Degrees of freedom must be a whole number of at least 1.';else if(raw>500)message='Please use no more than 500 degrees of freedom.';csdError.textContent=message;csdDf.setAttribute('aria-invalid',message?'true':'false');return message?null:raw}
function csdUpdateRanges(df){let maxX=Math.min(Math.max(csdQuantile(.995,df),10),Math.max(50,df*1.5));maxX=Math.ceil(maxX*10)/10;[csdXLess,csdXGreater,csdXLower,csdXUpper].forEach(slider=>{slider.max=maxX;if(+slider.value>maxX)slider.value=maxX});if(+csdXUpper.value<+csdXLower.value)csdXUpper.value=csdXLower.value;return maxX}
function csdDraw(df,maxX,type,probability){const rect=csdCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();if(!rect.width||!rect.height)return;const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;csdCanvas.width=Math.round(rect.width*dpr);csdCanvas.height=Math.round(rect.height*dpr);csdCtx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);const width=rect.width,height=rect.height,margin={left:58,right:20,top:18,bottom:44},plotWidth=width-margin.left-margin.right,plotHeight=height-margin.top-margin.bottom,points=700,xs=[],ys=[];let maxY=0;for(let i=0;i<=points;i++){const x=maxX*i/points,safe=x===0&&df<2?1e-6:x,y=csdPDF(safe,df);xs.push(x);ys.push(y);if(Number.isFinite(y)&&y>maxY)maxY=y}maxY=Math.max(.01,maxY*1.1);const px=x=>margin.left+x/maxX*plotWidth,py=y=>margin.top+plotHeight-Math.min(y,maxY)/maxY*plotHeight;csdCtx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);csdCtx.strokeStyle='#e5e5e5';csdCtx.lineWidth=1;for(let i=0;i<=5;i++){const y=margin.top+plotHeight*i/5;csdCtx.beginPath();csdCtx.moveTo(margin.left,y);csdCtx.lineTo(width-margin.right,y);csdCtx.stroke()}let start=0,end=0;if(type==='less'){end=+csdXLess.value}else if(type==='greater'){start=+csdXGreater.value;end=maxX}else{start=+csdXLower.value;end=+csdXUpper.value}start=Math.max(0,start);end=Math.min(maxX,end);csdCtx.beginPath();csdCtx.moveTo(px(start),py(0));for(let i=0;i<=points;i++){if(xs[i]>=start&&xs[i]<=end&&Number.isFinite(ys[i]))csdCtx.lineTo(px(xs[i]),py(ys[i]))}csdCtx.lineTo(px(end),py(0));csdCtx.closePath();csdCtx.fillStyle='rgba(63,104,182,.55)';csdCtx.fill();csdCtx.beginPath();let begun=false;for(let i=0;i<=points;i++){if(!Number.isFinite(ys[i]))continue;if(!begun){csdCtx.moveTo(px(xs[i]),py(ys[i]));begun=true}else csdCtx.lineTo(px(xs[i]),py(ys[i]))}csdCtx.strokeStyle='#555';csdCtx.lineWidth=2;csdCtx.stroke();csdCtx.save();csdCtx.setLineDash([5,5]);csdCtx.strokeStyle='#db4315';csdCtx.lineWidth=2;const boundaries=type==='between'?[+csdXLower.value,+csdXUpper.value]:[type==='less'?+csdXLess.value:+csdXGreater.value];boundaries.forEach(value=>{if(value>=0&&value<=maxX){csdCtx.beginPath();csdCtx.moveTo(px(value),margin.top);csdCtx.lineTo(px(value),margin.top+plotHeight);csdCtx.stroke()}});csdCtx.restore();csdCtx.strokeStyle='#555';csdCtx.lineWidth=1;csdCtx.beginPath();csdCtx.moveTo(margin.left,margin.top+plotHeight);csdCtx.lineTo(width-margin.right,margin.top+plotHeight);csdCtx.stroke();csdCtx.fillStyle='#555';csdCtx.font='12px Arial';csdCtx.textAlign='center';for(let i=0;i<=6;i++){const x=maxX*i/6,xpos=px(x);csdCtx.beginPath();csdCtx.moveTo(xpos,margin.top+plotHeight);csdCtx.lineTo(xpos,margin.top+plotHeight+5);csdCtx.stroke();csdCtx.fillText(x.toFixed(1),xpos,margin.top+plotHeight+20)}csdCtx.font='13px Arial';csdCtx.fillStyle='#333';csdCtx.fillText('X',margin.left+plotWidth/2,height-8);csdCtx.save();csdCtx.translate(15,margin.top+plotHeight/2);csdCtx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);csdCtx.fillText('Probability density function',0,0);csdCtx.restore();const text=`Chi-squared distribution with ${df} degrees of freedom.`;csdCanvas.setAttribute('aria-label',text);csdDescription.textContent=text}
function csdUpdate(){const df=csdValidateDf();if(df===null){csdResult.textContent='Enter valid degrees of freedom to calculate a probability.';csdCtx.clearRect(0,0,csdCanvas.width,csdCanvas.height);return}const maxX=csdUpdateRanges(df),type=csdType();csdPlotTitle.textContent=`Chi-Squared(k = ${df})`;let probability,explanation;if(type==='less'){const x=+csdXLess.value;probability=csdCDF(x,df);csdXLessValue.textContent=x.toFixed(1);explanation=`P(X ≤ ${x.toFixed(1)}) = ${probability.toFixed(6)} or ${(probability*100).toFixed(4)}%`}else if(type==='greater'){const x=+csdXGreater.value;probability=1-csdCDF(x,df);csdXGreaterValue.textContent=x.toFixed(1);explanation=`P(X ≥ ${x.toFixed(1)}) = ${probability.toFixed(6)} or ${(probability*100).toFixed(4)}%`}else{let lower=+csdXLower.value,upper=+csdXUpper.value;if(upper<lower){upper=lower;csdXUpper.value=upper}probability=csdCDF(upper,df)-csdCDF(lower,df);csdXLowerValue.textContent=lower.toFixed(1);csdXUpperValue.textContent=upper.toFixed(1);explanation=`P(${lower.toFixed(1)} ≤ X ≤ ${upper.toFixed(1)}) = ${probability.toFixed(6)} or ${(probability*100).toFixed(4)}%`}probability=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,probability));csdResult.innerHTML=`<span class="csd-probability-value">${explanation}</span>`;csdDraw(df,maxX,type,probability)}
function csdUpdateControls(){const type=csdType();csdLessControls.classList.toggle('csd-hidden',type!=='less');csdGreaterControls.classList.toggle('csd-hidden',type!=='greater');csdBetweenControls.classList.toggle('csd-hidden',type!=='between');csdUpdate()}
csdDf.addEventListener('input',csdUpdate);[csdXLess,csdXGreater].forEach(slider=>slider.addEventListener('input',csdUpdate));csdXLower.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(+csdXLower.value>+csdXUpper.value)csdXUpper.value=csdXLower.value;csdUpdate()});csdXUpper.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(+csdXUpper.value<+csdXLower.value)csdXLower.value=csdXUpper.value;csdUpdate()});csdRoot.querySelectorAll('input[name="csd-prob-type"]').forEach(radio=>radio.addEventListener('change',csdUpdateControls));let csdResizeTimer;window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(csdResizeTimer);csdResizeTimer=setTimeout(csdUpdate,80)});csdUpdateControls();
})();

**Examples:**

-   **Goodness of fit example:** You have a six-sided die with six possible outcomes: $1, 2, 3, 4, 5,$ and $6$. You calculate the expected frequencies of each outcome. Then you roll the die many times and record the observed frequencies of each outcome. Since there are 6 categories, $$\textsf{degrees of freedom = number of categories} - 1 = 6 - 1 = 5$$ This can be expressed as $X \sim \chi^2(5)$, meaning the degrees of freedom is $5$.

-   **Test for independence example:** You are investigating whether there is a correlation between two variables: candy colour and flavour. You have $5$ categories of colours and 3 categories of flavours. Calculating the degrees of freedom can be done with the formula: $$(\textsf{categories of colours} - 1)(\textsf{categories of flavours} - 1) = (5-1)(3-1)=(4)(2)=8.$$ You can model $X \sim \chi^2(8)$, meaning that there are $8$ degrees of freedom.

## $F$-distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The $F$-distribution is used for the ratio $(X/d_1)/(Y/d_2)$ of two independent random $\chi^2$ variables $X\sim \chi^2(d_1)$ and $Y\sim \chi^2(d_2)$. It is commonly used as a reference distribution in hypothesis testing to compare two variances or more than two means, such as Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) tests.

**Notation:** $X \sim F(d_{1},d_{2})$

**Parameters:** Two integers $d_1$ and $d_2$, where - $d_{1}$ degrees of freedom for the random variable $X\sim \chi^2(d_{1})$. - $d_{2}$ degrees of freedom for the random variable $Y\sim \chi^2(d_{2})$.

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{d_{2}}{d_{2}-2}$ | $d_2>2$ |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{2d_{2}(d_{1}+d_{2}-2)}{d_{1}(d_{2}-2)^2(d_{2}-4)}$ |  |
| **PDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{\sqrt{\frac{(d_{1}x)^{d_{1}}d_{2}^{d_{2}}}{(d_{1}x+d_{2})^{d_{1}+d_{2}}}}}{x\textrm{B}\left(\frac{d_{1}}{2},\frac{d_{2}}{2}\right)}$ | $\textrm{B}(x,y)$ is the beta function |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=I_{\frac{d_{1}x}{d_{1}x+d_{2}}}(\frac{d_{1}}{2},\frac{d_{2}}{2})$ | $I_{x}(a,b)$ is the regularized incomplete beta function |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = \dfrac{d_{2}}{d_{2}-2}$ for $d_{2}>2$. -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{2d_{2}(d_{1}+d_{2}-2)}{d_{1}(d_{2}-2)^2(d_{2}-4)}$ -->

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{\sqrt{\frac{(d_{1}x)^{d_{1}}d_{2}^{d_{2}}}{(d_{1}x+d_{2})^{d_{1}+d_{2}}}}}{x\textrm{B}\left(\frac{d_{1}}{2},\frac{d_{2}}{2}\right)}$ where $\textrm{B}(x,y)$ is the beta function of $x$ and $y$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=I_{\frac{d_{1}x}{d_{1}x+d_{2}}}(\frac{d_{1}}{2},\frac{d_{2}}{2})$ where $I_{x}(a,b)$ is the regularized incomplete beta function for $a$ and $b$ with $x$ being the upper bound for integration. -->

    .f-calculator .radio-option input {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      margin: 0;
      accent-color: #3F68B6;
    }

    .f-calculator .conditional-input { margin-top: 1rem; }
    .f-calculator .conditional-input[hidden] { display: none; }
    .f-calculator .upper-label { margin-top: 1rem; }

    .f-calculator .distribution-plot-title {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .f-calculator .f-chart-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 320px;
    }

    .f-calculator canvas {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
    }

    .f-calculator .calculation-result {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .f-calculator .input-error {
      min-height: 1.4em;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      color: #b00020;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .f-calculator input:focus,
    .f-calculator canvas:focus {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(63, 104, 182, 0.3);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .f-calculator .calculator-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .f-calculator .plot-card { min-width: 0; }
      .f-calculator .f-chart-wrapper { height: 280px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      body { padding: 0.5rem; }
      .f-calculator .calculator-card-body { padding: 0.9rem; }
      .f-calculator .f-chart-wrapper { height: 250px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="distribution-calculator f-calculator">

  <div class="calculator-row">

    <!-- PARAMETERS CARD -->
    <div class="calculator-card parameters-card">
      <div class="calculator-card-header">Parameters</div>

      <div class="calculator-card-body">

        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="f-df1">Numerator degrees of freedom (d₁):</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="f-df1"
            value="5"
            min="1"
            max="500"
            step="1"
            aria-describedby="f-parameter-error">
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="f-df2">Denominator degrees of freedom (d₂):</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="f-df2"
            value="10"
            min="1"
            max="500"
            step="1"
            aria-describedby="f-parameter-error">
        </div>

        <div
          id="f-parameter-error"
          class="input-error"
          role="alert"
          aria-live="assertive">
        </div>

        <hr>

        <fieldset class="probability-options">
          <legend>Probability to calculate:</legend>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input type="radio" name="f-prob-type" value="less" checked>
            <span>P(F ≤ x)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input type="radio" name="f-prob-type" value="greater">
            <span>P(F ≥ x)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input type="radio" name="f-prob-type" value="between">
            <span>P(a ≤ F ≤ b)</span>
          </label>
        </fieldset>

        <!-- SINGLE X VALUE -->
        <div id="f-x-container" class="conditional-input">
          <label for="f-x">x value:</label>
          <input
            type="range"
            id="f-x"
            min="0"
            max="8"
            value="2"
            step="0.01"
            class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="f-x-value">2.00</div>
        </div>

        <!-- LOWER / UPPER VALUES -->
        <div id="f-between-container" class="conditional-input" hidden>
          <label for="f-lower">Lower bound (a):</label>
          <input
            type="range"
            id="f-lower"
            min="0"
            max="8"
            value="0.5"
            step="0.01"
            class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="f-lower-value">0.50</div>

          <label for="f-upper" class="upper-label">Upper bound (b):</label>
          <input
            type="range"
            id="f-upper"
            min="0"
            max="8"
            value="3"
            step="0.01"
            class="distribution-slider">
          <div class="slider-value" id="f-upper-value">3.00</div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PLOT CARD -->
    <div class="calculator-card plot-card">
      <div class="calculator-card-header">F-distribution plot</div>

      <div class="calculator-card-body">
        <div id="f-plot-title" class="distribution-plot-title">
          F(d₁ = 5, d₂ = 10)
        </div>

        <div class="f-chart-wrapper">
          <canvas
            id="f-chart"
            tabindex="0"
            role="img"
            aria-label="F-distribution probability density function">
          </canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- RESULTS CARD -->
  <div class="calculator-card results-card">
    <div class="calculator-card-header">Results</div>
    <div class="calculator-card-body">
      <div
        id="f-result"
        class="calculation-result"
        aria-live="polite"
        aria-atomic="true">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   F-DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {
  "use strict";

  const root = document.querySelector(".f-calculator");
  if (!root) return;

  const df1Input = root.querySelector("#f-df1");
  const df2Input = root.querySelector("#f-df2");
  const xInput = root.querySelector("#f-x");
  const lowerInput = root.querySelector("#f-lower");
  const upperInput = root.querySelector("#f-upper");

  const xDisplay = root.querySelector("#f-x-value");
  const lowerDisplay = root.querySelector("#f-lower-value");
  const upperDisplay = root.querySelector("#f-upper-value");

  const error = root.querySelector("#f-parameter-error");
  const title = root.querySelector("#f-plot-title");
  const result = root.querySelector("#f-result");
  const xContainer = root.querySelector("#f-x-container");
  const betweenContainer = root.querySelector("#f-between-container");
  const canvas = root.querySelector("#f-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function logGamma(z) {
    const coefficients = [
      676.5203681218851,
      -1259.1392167224028,
      771.32342877765313,
      -176.61502916214059,
      12.507343278686905,
      -0.13857109526572012,
      9.9843695780195716e-6,
      1.5056327351493116e-7
    ];

    if (z < 0.5) {
      return Math.log(Math.PI) -
        Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI * z)) -
        logGamma(1 - z);
    }

    z -= 1;
    let total = 0.99999999999980993;

    for (let i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
      total += coefficients[i] / (z + i + 1);
    }

    const t = z + coefficients.length - 0.5;

    return 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) +
      (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) - t + Math.log(total);
  }

  function betaContinuedFraction(a, b, x) {
    const maxIterations = 250;
    const epsilon = 3e-14;
    const tiny = 1e-300;
    const qab = a + b;
    const qap = a + 1;
    const qam = a - 1;

    let c = 1;
    let d = 1 - qab * x / qap;
    if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
    d = 1 / d;
    let h = d;

    for (let m = 1; m <= maxIterations; m++) {
      const m2 = 2 * m;
      let aa = m * (b - m) * x /
        ((qam + m2) * (a + m2));

      d = 1 + aa * d;
      if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
      c = 1 + aa / c;
      if (Math.abs(c) < tiny) c = tiny;
      d = 1 / d;
      h *= d * c;

      aa = -(a + m) * (qab + m) * x /
        ((a + m2) * (qap + m2));

      d = 1 + aa * d;
      if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
      c = 1 + aa / c;
      if (Math.abs(c) < tiny) c = tiny;
      d = 1 / d;

      const delta = d * c;
      h *= delta;

      if (Math.abs(delta - 1) < epsilon) break;
    }

    return h;
  }

  function regularizedIncompleteBeta(x, a, b) {
    if (x <= 0) return 0;
    if (x >= 1) return 1;

    const logarithmicTerm =
      logGamma(a + b) - logGamma(a) - logGamma(b) +
      a * Math.log(x) + b * Math.log(1 - x);

    const front = Math.exp(logarithmicTerm);

    if (x < (a + 1) / (a + b + 2)) {
      return front * betaContinuedFraction(a, b, x) / a;
    }

    return 1 - front * betaContinuedFraction(b, a, 1 - x) / b;
  }

  function fPDF(value, df1, df2) {
    if (value <= 0) return 0;

    const halfDf1 = df1 / 2;
    const halfDf2 = df2 / 2;

    const logDensity =
      halfDf1 * Math.log(df1 / df2) +
      (halfDf1 - 1) * Math.log(value) -
      (halfDf1 + halfDf2) * Math.log(1 + df1 * value / df2) -
      (logGamma(halfDf1) + logGamma(halfDf2) -
       logGamma(halfDf1 + halfDf2));

    return Math.exp(logDensity);
  }

  function fCDF(value, df1, df2) {
    if (value <= 0) return 0;

    const transformed =
      (df1 * value) / (df1 * value + df2);

    return regularizedIncompleteBeta(
      transformed,
      df1 / 2,
      df2 / 2
    );
  }

  function fQuantile(probability, df1, df2) {
    let lower = 0;
    let upper = 1;

    while (fCDF(upper, df1, df2) < probability && upper < 10000) {
      upper *= 2;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      const midpoint = (lower + upper) / 2;

      if (fCDF(midpoint, df1, df2) < probability) {
        lower = midpoint;
      } else {
        upper = midpoint;
      }
    }

    return (lower + upper) / 2;
  }

  function validateParameters() {
    const df1 = Number(df1Input.value);
    const df2 = Number(df2Input.value);
    let message = "";

    if (!Number.isInteger(df1) || !Number.isInteger(df2)) {
      message = "Both degrees of freedom must be whole numbers.";
    } else if (df1 < 1 || df2 < 1) {
      message = "Both degrees of freedom must be at least 1.";
    } else if (df1 > 500 || df2 > 500) {
      message = "Please use degrees of freedom no greater than 500.";
    }

    error.textContent = message;
    df1Input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", message ? "true" : "false");
    df2Input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", message ? "true" : "false");

    return message ? null : { df1, df2 };
  }

  function getProbabilityType() {
    const selected = root.querySelector(
      'input[name="f-prob-type"]:checked'
    );
    return selected ? selected.value : "less";
  }

  function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) {
    return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, value));
  }

  function formatValue(value) {
    return Number(value).toFixed(2);
  }

  function updateRanges(parameters) {
    const quantile = fQuantile(0.995, parameters.df1, parameters.df2);
    const maximum = Math.min(100, Math.max(5, quantile));
    const step = Math.max(0.001, maximum / 500);

    [xInput, lowerInput, upperInput].forEach(function(input) {
      input.min = 0;
      input.max = maximum;
      input.step = step;

      const current = Number(input.value);
      input.value = Number.isFinite(current)
        ? clamp(current, 0, maximum)
        : 0;
    });

    if (Number(upperInput.value) < Number(lowerInput.value)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }

    return maximum;
  }

  function updateDisplay(parameters) {
    const plotMaximum = updateRanges(parameters);

    xDisplay.textContent = formatValue(xInput.value);
    lowerDisplay.textContent = formatValue(lowerInput.value);
    upperDisplay.textContent = formatValue(upperInput.value);

    title.textContent =
      `F(d₁ = ${parameters.df1}, d₂ = ${parameters.df2})`;

    return plotMaximum;
  }

  function calculateProbability(parameters) {
    const df1 = parameters.df1;
    const df2 = parameters.df2;
    const x = Number(xInput.value);
    let lower = Number(lowerInput.value);
    let upper = Number(upperInput.value);
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    let probability;

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper;
      upperDisplay.textContent = formatValue(upper);
    }

    if (type === "less") {
      probability = fCDF(x, df1, df2);
      result.textContent =
        `P(F ≤ ${formatValue(x)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if (type === "greater") {
      probability = 1 - fCDF(x, df1, df2);
      result.textContent =
        `P(F ≥ ${formatValue(x)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      probability =
        fCDF(upper, df1, df2) -
        fCDF(lower, df1, df2);

      result.textContent =
        `P(${formatValue(lower)} ≤ F ≤ ${formatValue(upper)}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} or ` +
        `${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }

    probability = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probability));

    return {
      type,
      x,
      lower,
      upper,
      probability,
      df1,
      df2
    };
  }

  function drawChart(parameters, plotMaximum) {
    const selected = calculateProbability(parameters);
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 62, right: 22, top: 25, bottom: 52 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const pointCount = 800;
    const epsilon = Math.max(1e-6, plotMaximum / pointCount / 10);
    const points = [];
    let maximumY = 0;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    for (let i = 0; i <= pointCount; i++) {
      const value = epsilon +
        (i / pointCount) * (plotMaximum - epsilon);
      const density = fPDF(value, selected.df1, selected.df2);

      if (Number.isFinite(density)) {
        points.push({ value, density });
        maximumY = Math.max(maximumY, density);
      }
    }

    maximumY = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(50, maximumY * 1.1));

    function xScale(value) {
      return padding.left + (value / plotMaximum) * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      const bounded = Math.min(value, maximumY);
      return padding.top + chartHeight -
        (bounded / maximumY) * chartHeight;
    }

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const density = (i / 4) * maximumY;
      const y = yScale(density);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(density.toFixed(2), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    function fillArea(start, end, colour) {
      const boundedStart = clamp(start, 0, plotMaximum);
      const boundedEnd = clamp(end, 0, plotMaximum);
      if (boundedEnd <= boundedStart) return;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(boundedStart), yScale(0));
      let hasPoint = false;

      points.forEach(function(point) {
        if (point.value >= boundedStart && point.value <= boundedEnd) {
          ctx.lineTo(xScale(point.value), yScale(point.density));
          hasPoint = true;
        }
      });

      if (!hasPoint) return;

      ctx.lineTo(xScale(boundedEnd), yScale(0));
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = colour;
      ctx.fill();
    }

    fillArea(0, plotMaximum, "rgba(211, 211, 211, 0.55)");

    if (selected.type === "less") {
      fillArea(0, selected.x, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    } else if (selected.type === "greater") {
      fillArea(selected.x, plotMaximum, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    } else {
      fillArea(selected.lower, selected.upper, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    }

    ctx.beginPath();

    points.forEach(function(point, index) {
      const chartX = xScale(point.value);
      const chartY = yScale(point.density);

      if (index === 0) ctx.moveTo(chartX, chartY);
      else ctx.lineTo(chartX, chartY);
    });

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    function drawBoundary(value) {
      if (value < 0 || value > plotMaximum) return;

      const density = value <= 0
        ? 0
        : fPDF(value, selected.df1, selected.df2);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(value), yScale(0));
      ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(density));
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (selected.type === "between") {
      drawBoundary(selected.lower);
      drawBoundary(selected.upper);
    } else {
      drawBoundary(selected.x);
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    const tickCount = width < 500 ? 5 : 8;

    for (let i = 0; i <= tickCount; i++) {
      const value = (i / tickCount) * plotMaximum;

      ctx.fillText(
        formatValue(value),
        xScale(value),
        padding.top + chartHeight + 20
      );
    }

    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(
      "F value",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("probability density", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `F-distribution probability density plot with ${selected.df1} ` +
      `numerator and ${selected.df2} denominator degrees of freedom. ` +
      `The selected probability is ${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`
    );
  }

  function updateVisibility() {
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    xContainer.hidden = type === "between";
    betweenContainer.hidden = type !== "between";
  }

  function update() {
    updateVisibility();

    const parameters = validateParameters();

    if (!parameters) {
      result.textContent =
        "Enter valid degrees of freedom to calculate a probability.";
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      return;
    }

    const plotMaximum = updateDisplay(parameters);
    drawChart(parameters, plotMaximum);
  }

  df1Input.addEventListener("input", update);
  df2Input.addEventListener("input", update);
  xInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  lowerInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (Number(lowerInput.value) > Number(upperInput.value)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  upperInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (Number(upperInput.value) < Number(lowerInput.value)) {
      lowerInput.value = upperInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  root.querySelectorAll('input[name="f-prob-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(update, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

```

**Example:** You have three independent groups of data containing Cantor’s Confectionery chocolate bar lengths, and the total sample size is 90. From this, you would like to conduct an ANOVA test investigating if there is a statistically significant difference between the means of each group. You can find the degrees of freedom using the following methods:

-   $\textsf{numerator degrees of freedom = number of groups} - 1 = 3 - 1 = 2$

-   $\textsf{denominator degrees of freedom = sample size - number of groups} = 90 - 3 = 87$

The $F$ distribution, which will be used as a reference distribution for the ANOVA test, can be expressed as $X \sim F(2,87)$, meaning the numerator degrees of freedom is $2$ and the denominator degrees of freedom is $87$.

## $t$-distribution {.unnumbered}

**Where to use:** The $t$-distribution is a special case of the $F$-distribution, as $(t(\nu))^2 = F(1,\nu)$. This distribution is used for continuous random variables with heavier tails than the normal distribution, and it is often employed in hypothesis testing where the population standard deviation is unknown. (See [Guide: Introduction to hypothesis testing](../studyguides/hypothesistesting.qmd) for more.)

**Notation:** $X \sim t(\nu)$

**Parameter:** The integer $\nu$ representing the degrees of freedom.

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Mean** | $\mathbb{E}(X) = 0$ |  |
| **Variance** | $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{\nu}{\nu -2}$ | $\nu > 2$ |
| **PDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{\Gamma\left(\frac{\nu+1}{2}\right)}{\Gamma\left(\frac{\nu}{2}\right)\sqrt{\pi \nu}}\left(1+\frac{x^2}{\nu}\right)^{-\frac{\nu+1}{2}}$ | $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function |
| **CDF** | $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\dfrac{1}{2}+x\Gamma\left(\frac{\nu+1}{2}\right)\left(\frac{_{2}F_{1}\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{\nu+1}{2};\frac{3}{2};-\frac{x^2}{\nu}\right)}{\Gamma\left(\frac{\nu}{2}\right)\sqrt{\pi \nu}}\right)$ | $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function, $_{2}F_{1}(a,b;c;z)$ is the hypergeometric function |

<!-- **Mean/expected value:** $\mathbb{E}(X) = 0$ -->

<!-- **Variance:** $\mathbb{V}(X) = \dfrac{\nu}{\nu -2}$ for $\nu>2$. -->

<!-- **PDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X=x)=\dfrac{\Gamma\left(\frac{\nu+1}{2}\right)}{\Gamma\left(\frac{\nu}{2}\right)\sqrt{\pi \nu}}\left(1+\frac{x^2}{\nu}\right)^{-\frac{\nu+1}{2}}$ where $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function of $x$. -->

<!-- **CDF:** $\mathbb{P}(X \leq x)=\dfrac{1}{2}+x\Gamma\left(\frac{\nu+1}{2}\right)\left(\frac{_{2}F_{1}\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{\nu+1}{2};\frac{3}{2};-\frac{x^2}{\nu}\right)}{\Gamma\left(\frac{\nu}{2}\right)\sqrt{\pi \nu}}\right)$ where $\Gamma(x)$ is the gamma function of $x$ and $_{2}F_{1}(a,b;c;z)$ is the hypergeometric function for $a, b, c,$ and $z$. -->

 

**Figure**

```{=html}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>t-Distribution Calculator</title>

  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: #f5f6f8;
      color: #222222;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       T-DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
       ========================================================= */

    .t-calculator {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* TOP ROW */

    .t-calculator .calculator-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    /* CARDS */

    .t-calculator .calculator-card {
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid #dddddd;
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    /* CARD HEADERS */

    .t-calculator .calculator-card-header {
      background: #3F6BB6;
      color: #ffffff;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* CARD BODY */

    .t-calculator .calculator-card-body {
      padding: 1rem;
    }

    /* FORM ELEMENTS */

    .t-calculator .form-group {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .t-calculator label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .t-calculator input[type="number"] {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
      border: 1px solid #cccccc;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    /* SLIDERS */

    .t-calculator .distribution-slider {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0.5rem 0;
      accent-color: #3F68B6;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .t-calculator .slider-value {
      text-align: center;
      color: #3F68B6;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-top: 0.1rem;
    }

    /* DIVIDER */

    .t-calculator hr {
      border: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid #dddddd;
      margin: 1.2rem 0;
    }

    /* RADIO BUTTONS */

    .t-calculator .probability-options {
      border: 0;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .t-calculator .probability-options legend {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }

    .t-calculator .radio-option {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    .t-calculator .radio-option input {
      margin: 0;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      accent-color: #3F68B6;
    }

    /* CONDITIONAL INPUTS */

    .t-calculator .conditional-input {
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .t-calculator .conditional-input[hidden] {
      display: none;
    }

    .t-calculator .upper-label {
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    /* PLOT */

    .t-calculator .distribution-plot-title {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .t-calculator .t-chart-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 320px;
    }

    .t-calculator canvas {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
    }

    /* RESULTS */

    .t-calculator .calculation-result {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* FOCUS */

    .t-calculator input:focus,
    .t-calculator canvas:focus {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(63, 104, 182, 0.3);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    /* MOBILE */

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .t-calculator .calculator-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .t-calculator .plot-card {
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .t-calculator .t-chart-wrapper {
        height: 280px;
      }
    }

    /* SMALL MOBILE */

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      body {
        padding: 0.5rem;
      }

      .t-calculator .calculator-card-body {
        padding: 0.9rem;
      }

      .t-calculator .t-chart-wrapper {
        height: 250px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="distribution-calculator t-calculator">

  <div class="calculator-row">

    <!-- PARAMETERS CARD -->
    <div class="calculator-card parameters-card">

      <div class="calculator-card-header">
        Parameters
      </div>

      <div class="calculator-card-body">

        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="t-df">
            Degrees of freedom (&nu;):
          </label>

          <input
            type="number"
            id="t-df"
            value="10"
            min="1"
            max="500"
            step="1"
            class="form-control">
        </div>

        <hr>

        <fieldset class="probability-options">

          <legend>
            Probability to calculate:
          </legend>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="t-prob-type"
              value="less"
              checked>
            <span>P(X &le; t)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="t-prob-type"
              value="greater">
            <span>P(X &ge; t)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="t-prob-type"
              value="between">
            <span>P(a &le; X &le; b)</span>
          </label>

        </fieldset>

        <!-- SINGLE T VALUE -->
        <div id="t-value-container" class="conditional-input">

          <label for="t-value">
            t value:
          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="t-value"
            min="-5"
            max="5"
            value="1.5"
            step="0.1"
            class="distribution-slider">

          <div class="slider-value" id="t-value-display">
            1.5
          </div>

        </div>

        <!-- LOWER / UPPER VALUES -->
        <div id="t-between-container" class="conditional-input" hidden>

          <label for="t-lower">
            Lower bound (a):
          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="t-lower"
            min="-5"
            max="5"
            value="-1"
            step="0.1"
            class="distribution-slider">

          <div class="slider-value" id="t-lower-value">
            -1.0
          </div>

          <label for="t-upper" class="upper-label">
            Upper bound (b):
          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="t-upper"
            min="-5"
            max="5"
            value="1"
            step="0.1"
            class="distribution-slider">

          <div class="slider-value" id="t-upper-value">
            1.0
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PLOT CARD -->
    <div class="calculator-card plot-card">

      <div class="calculator-card-header">
        t-distribution plot
      </div>

      <div class="calculator-card-body">

        <div id="t-plot-title" class="distribution-plot-title">
          t(&nu; = 10)
        </div>

        <div class="t-chart-wrapper">
          <canvas
            id="t-chart"
            tabindex="0"
            role="img"
            aria-label="Student's t-distribution probability density function">
          </canvas>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- RESULTS CARD -->
  <div class="calculator-card results-card">

    <div class="calculator-card-header">
      Results
    </div>

    <div class="calculator-card-body">
      <div id="t-result" class="calculation-result" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   STUDENT'S T-DISTRIBUTION CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

(function() {
  "use strict";

  const root = document.querySelector(".t-calculator");
  if (!root) return;

  const dfInput = root.querySelector("#t-df");
  const tInput = root.querySelector("#t-value");
  const lowerInput = root.querySelector("#t-lower");
  const upperInput = root.querySelector("#t-upper");

  const tDisplay = root.querySelector("#t-value-display");
  const lowerDisplay = root.querySelector("#t-lower-value");
  const upperDisplay = root.querySelector("#t-upper-value");

  const title = root.querySelector("#t-plot-title");
  const result = root.querySelector("#t-result");
  const valueContainer = root.querySelector("#t-value-container");
  const betweenContainer = root.querySelector("#t-between-container");
  const canvas = root.querySelector("#t-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  /* LANCZOS LOG-GAMMA APPROXIMATION */

  function logGamma(z) {
    const coefficients = [
      676.5203681218851,
      -1259.1392167224028,
      771.32342877765313,
      -176.61502916214059,
      12.507343278686905,
      -0.13857109526572012,
      9.9843695780195716e-6,
      1.5056327351493116e-7
    ];

    if (z < 0.5) {
      return Math.log(Math.PI) -
        Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI * z)) -
        logGamma(1 - z);
    }

    z -= 1;
    let x = 0.99999999999980993;

    for (let i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
      x += coefficients[i] / (z + i + 1);
    }

    const t = z + coefficients.length - 0.5;

    return 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) +
      (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) - t + Math.log(x);
  }

  /* CONTINUED FRACTION FOR THE INCOMPLETE BETA FUNCTION */

  function betaContinuedFraction(a, b, x) {
    const maxIterations = 200;
    const epsilon = 3e-14;
    const tiny = 1e-300;
    const qab = a + b;
    const qap = a + 1;
    const qam = a - 1;

    let c = 1;
    let d = 1 - qab * x / qap;
    if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
    d = 1 / d;
    let h = d;

    for (let m = 1; m <= maxIterations; m++) {
      const m2 = 2 * m;
      let aa = m * (b - m) * x /
        ((qam + m2) * (a + m2));

      d = 1 + aa * d;
      if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
      c = 1 + aa / c;
      if (Math.abs(c) < tiny) c = tiny;
      d = 1 / d;
      h *= d * c;

      aa = -(a + m) * (qab + m) * x /
        ((a + m2) * (qap + m2));

      d = 1 + aa * d;
      if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
      c = 1 + aa / c;
      if (Math.abs(c) < tiny) c = tiny;
      d = 1 / d;

      const delta = d * c;
      h *= delta;

      if (Math.abs(delta - 1) < epsilon) break;
    }

    return h;
  }

  function regularizedIncompleteBeta(x, a, b) {
    if (x <= 0) return 0;
    if (x >= 1) return 1;

    const logarithmicTerm =
      logGamma(a + b) - logGamma(a) - logGamma(b) +
      a * Math.log(x) + b * Math.log(1 - x);

    const front = Math.exp(logarithmicTerm);

    if (x < (a + 1) / (a + b + 2)) {
      return front * betaContinuedFraction(a, b, x) / a;
    }

    return 1 - front * betaContinuedFraction(b, a, 1 - x) / b;
  }

  /* T-DISTRIBUTION PDF AND CDF */

  function tPDF(value, df) {
    const logCoefficient =
      logGamma((df + 1) / 2) -
      logGamma(df / 2) -
      0.5 * Math.log(df * Math.PI);

    return Math.exp(
      logCoefficient -
      ((df + 1) / 2) * Math.log(1 + value * value / df)
    );
  }

  function tCDF(value, df) {
    if (value === 0) return 0.5;

    const betaX = df / (df + value * value);
    const beta = regularizedIncompleteBeta(betaX, df / 2, 0.5);

    return value > 0 ? 1 - 0.5 * beta : 0.5 * beta;
  }

  function getProbabilityType() {
    const selected = root.querySelector(
      'input[name="t-prob-type"]:checked'
    );

    return selected ? selected.value : "less";
  }

  function validateDegreesOfFreedom() {
    let df = parseInt(dfInput.value, 10);

    if (!Number.isFinite(df) || df < 1) df = 1;
    if (df > 500) df = 500;

    dfInput.value = df;
    return df;
  }

  function updateDisplay() {
    const df = validateDegreesOfFreedom();

    tDisplay.textContent = parseFloat(tInput.value).toFixed(1);
    lowerDisplay.textContent = parseFloat(lowerInput.value).toFixed(1);
    upperDisplay.textContent = parseFloat(upperInput.value).toFixed(1);
    title.textContent = `t(ν = ${df})`;
  }

  function calculateProbability() {
    const df = validateDegreesOfFreedom();
    const t = parseFloat(tInput.value);
    let lower = parseFloat(lowerInput.value);
    let upper = parseFloat(upperInput.value);
    const type = getProbabilityType();

    if (upper < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      upperInput.value = upper.toFixed(1);
      upperDisplay.textContent = upper.toFixed(1);
    }

    let probability;

    if (type === "less") {
      probability = tCDF(t, df);
      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≤ ${t.toFixed(1)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else if (type === "greater") {
      probability = 1 - tCDF(t, df);
      result.textContent =
        `P(X ≥ ${t.toFixed(1)}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)} ` +
        `or ${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    } else {
      probability = tCDF(upper, df) - tCDF(lower, df);
      result.textContent =
        `P(${lower.toFixed(1)} ≤ X ≤ ${upper.toFixed(1)}) = ` +
        `${probability.toFixed(4)} or ` +
        `${(probability * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
    }

    probability = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probability));

    return { type, t, lower, upper, probability, df };
  }

  function drawChart() {
    const selected = calculateProbability();
    const df = selected.df;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 62, right: 22, top: 25, bottom: 52 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const selectedMagnitude = selected.type === "between"
      ? Math.max(Math.abs(selected.lower), Math.abs(selected.upper))
      : Math.abs(selected.t);

    const maximumX = Math.max(5, selectedMagnitude * 1.25);
    const minimumX = -maximumX;
    const maximumY = tPDF(0, df) * 1.12;
    const pointCount = Math.max(600, Math.round(chartWidth * 1.7));

    function xScale(value) {
      return padding.left +
        ((value - minimumX) / (maximumX - minimumX)) * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      return padding.top + chartHeight -
        (value / maximumY) * chartHeight;
    }

    /* GRID AND Y LABELS */

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const density = (i / 4) * maximumY;
      const y = yScale(density);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(density.toFixed(2), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    function fillArea(start, end, colour) {
      const boundedStart = Math.max(minimumX, Math.min(maximumX, start));
      const boundedEnd = Math.max(minimumX, Math.min(maximumX, end));

      if (boundedEnd <= boundedStart) return;

      const count = Math.max(
        2,
        Math.round(
          pointCount *
          (boundedEnd - boundedStart) /
          (maximumX - minimumX)
        )
      );

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(boundedStart), yScale(0));

      for (let i = 0; i <= count; i++) {
        const value = boundedStart +
          (i / count) * (boundedEnd - boundedStart);

        ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(tPDF(value, df)));
      }

      ctx.lineTo(xScale(boundedEnd), yScale(0));
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = colour;
      ctx.fill();
    }

    /* BACKGROUND AND SELECTED REGION */

    fillArea(minimumX, maximumX, "rgba(211, 211, 211, 0.55)");

    if (selected.type === "less") {
      fillArea(minimumX, selected.t, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    } else if (selected.type === "greater") {
      fillArea(selected.t, maximumX, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    } else {
      fillArea(selected.lower, selected.upper, "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.58)");
    }

    /* DENSITY CURVE */

    ctx.beginPath();

    for (let i = 0; i <= pointCount; i++) {
      const value = minimumX +
        (i / pointCount) * (maximumX - minimumX);
      const x = xScale(value);
      const y = yScale(tPDF(value, df));

      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    /* BOUNDARY LINES */

    function drawBoundary(value) {
      if (value < minimumX || value > maximumX) return;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#274f91";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(value), yScale(0));
      ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(tPDF(value, df)));
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (selected.type === "between") {
      drawBoundary(selected.lower);
      drawBoundary(selected.upper);
    } else {
      drawBoundary(selected.t);
    }

    /* AXES */

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    /* ZERO REFERENCE LINE */

    ctx.save();
    ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#aaaaaa";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xScale(0), padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(xScale(0), padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    /* X-AXIS LABELS */

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    const tickCount = width < 500 ? 6 : 10;

    for (let i = 0; i <= tickCount; i++) {
      const value = minimumX +
        (i / tickCount) * (maximumX - minimumX);

      ctx.fillText(
        value.toFixed(1),
        xScale(value),
        padding.top + chartHeight + 20
      );
    }

    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(
      "t value",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    /* Y-AXIS TITLE */

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("probability density", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `Student's t-distribution plot with ${df} degrees of freedom. ` +
      `The selected probability is ${selected.probability.toFixed(4)}.`
    );
  }

  function updateVisibility() {
    const type = getProbabilityType();
    valueContainer.hidden = type === "between";
    betweenContainer.hidden = type !== "between";
  }

  function update() {
    updateVisibility();
    updateDisplay();
    drawChart();
  }

  dfInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  dfInput.addEventListener("change", update);
  tInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  lowerInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseFloat(lowerInput.value) > parseFloat(upperInput.value)) {
      upperInput.value = lowerInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  upperInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if (parseFloat(upperInput.value) < parseFloat(lowerInput.value)) {
      lowerInput.value = upperInput.value;
    }
    update();
  });

  root.querySelectorAll('input[name="t-prob-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(drawChart, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>


```

**Example:** You have a sample of 40 measurements of Cantor’s Confectionery chocolate bar lengths. From this, you would like to conduct a one sample $t$-test comparing the sample to a hypothesized mean. You find the degrees of freedom:

$$
\textsf{degrees of freedom = sample size} - 1 = 40 - 1 = 39
$$

The $t$ distribution, which will be used as a reference distribution for the $t$-test, can be expressed as $X \sim t(39)$, meaning the degrees of freedom is 39. See [Guide: Introduction to hypothesis testing](../studyguides/hypothesistesting.qmd) for more.

# Further reading {.unnumbered}

For more information on hypothesis testing, please see [Guide: Introduction to hypothesis testing](../studyguides/hypothesistesting.qmd).

For more information on probability, please see [Guide: Introduction to probability](../studyguides/introtoprobability.qmd).

For more information on mean, expected value, variance, and standard deviation, please see [Guide: Expected value, variance, standard deviation](../studyguides/expectedvariance.qmd).

For more information on PMFs, PDFs, and CDFs, please see [Guide: PMFs, PDFs, and CDFs.](../studyguides/pmfspdfscdfs.qmd)
